title: Executive Thai Chef assistant
description:
Role Description

We are looking for a skilled and passionate Thai chef to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for preparing authentic Thai dishes while ensuring high standards of quality, consistency, and presentation. You will work closely with the kitchen team to maintain an efficient workflow and uphold food safety regulations.

Qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in a Thai cooking

  • Strong culinary skills and expertise in food preparation techniques

  • Experience in maintaining food quality and consistency

  • Keen attention to detail and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills

  • Solid understanding of food safety and sanitation regulations

  • Prior experience in a similar role is a plus

  • Culinary certification or relevant education preferred

  • Able to communicate effectively in English at an A2 proficiency level or higher. A valid test certificate is required as proof

 

 

About Wokshop

Wokshop – A Bite of Thailand is all about authentic Thai flavors, fresh ingredients, and a relaxed dining experience. We blend delicious Thai cuisine with warm hospitality, stylish surroundings, and fair prices, creating the perfect balance of quality and comfort. Since opening our doors in 2000, we’ve grown to 13 restaurants, each offering both dine-in and takeaway, bringing the taste of Thailand to more people every day.

title: Qualified Carpenter with Glazing Experience - Construction - Lolland
description:
Bonde Glas is looking for a qualified carpenter with knowledge or experience of the glazing trade to join our team on Lolland in southern Denmark.

You'll need to already have the legal right to work in Denmark (for example, EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship, or a valid Danish work and residence permit). Unfortunately, we're not able to offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Your role

You will work with a wide range of carpentry tasks and work closely with the glazing side of the company. We are therefore looking for a carpenter who is comfortable with varied practical work and interested in working across the two trades.

Who you are

You are a qualified carpenter

You have knowledge or practical experience of the glazing trade

You have a valid driving licence

You can communicate in English

Is willing to relocate to Lolland and make the area your place of residence

A valid asbestos training certificate is a strong advantage

What we offer

Gross hourly wage: DKK 150-200, depending on qualifications and experience

Permanent employment, 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday

Occasional overtime may occur, but weekend work is generally not required

Pension scheme

Flexible benefits account for extra vacation, salary or pension

Assistance with finding suitable accommodation

About Bonde Glas

Bonde Glas is a local glazing company on Lolland. In addition to glazing work, the company also employs carpenters and carries out a wide range of practical assignments.

Recruitment Process

The first interview can be conducted online if required. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the workplace before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Please send your application to rekruttering@lolland.dk and write "Bonde Glas" in the subject line.

If you have questions about the position, please contact:

Martin Hansen
Business Consultant and EURES adviser, Lolland Municipality
Phone: +45 21 47 73 43
Email: maha@lolland.dk

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and Relocation Support

Lolland is located in the southern part of Denmark, offering a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to nature, beaches, and open countryside. The region combines affordable housing, short commuting distances, and a strong sense of community.

The region is currently experiencing significant development, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link, one of Europe's largest infrastructure projects, which will create a direct road and rail connection between Denmark and Germany.

As an international employee, you will have access to Lolland Municipality's Newcomers Service, which offers free support with relocation, registration, housing guidance, partner job support, and settling into life in Denmark.

For more information about Lolland and contact details, visit newcomers.lolland.dk

More information about living and working in Denmark can be found at www.workindenmark.dk

title: SERVICELEDER
description:
WE ARE HIRING – SERVICE MANAGER FOR OUR COPENHAGEN DEPARTMENT

Are you a strong leader with a hands-on approach, excellent organizational skills, and a passion for delivering high-quality service?

We are looking for a dedicated and responsible Service Manager to join our cleaning operations in Copenhagen.

As a Service Manager, you will play an important role in our daily operations and act as the link between our clients, cleaning staff, and management. Your main responsibility will be to ensure that our clients receive reliable, professional, and high-quality cleaning services.

Your main responsibilities will include:
• Managing and coordinating cleaning staff
• Ensuring high cleaning standards and carrying out quality checks
• Maintaining regular communication with clients
• Staff scheduling and daily planning
• Training and onboarding new employees
• Handling day-to-day operational challenges
• Following up on client satisfaction and employee performance

We are looking for someone who:
• Is responsible, service-minded, and solution-oriented
• Has strong leadership and communication skills
• Is organized and able to manage multiple tasks
• Has experience in the cleaning industry or a similar service environment – preferably in a supervisory or management role
• Is comfortable working with employees from different backgrounds
• Can communicate effectively in Danish and English

Location: Copenhagen

Does this sound like you – or do you know the right person?

Send us your application and CV, or contact us to learn more about the position.

title: Chauffør søges til blandet kørsel / Truck Driver – Mixed Transport
description:
Da vi er i rivende udvikling søger vi derfor nye Medarbejder til vores Transport afd. Søger vi 5 nye lastbilchauffør til blandet kørsel

Dag Log – Brøndby (Storkøbenhavn)

Er du en stabil, ansvarsbevidst og erfaren lastbilchauffør, som trives med varierende opgaver? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til vores team hos Dag Log.

Vi søger en lastbilchauffør til blandet kørsel, hvor opgaverne kan variere mellem distributionskørsel, afhentning og levering samt eventuelt længere ture – afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og ønsker.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fuldtidsstilling med ordnede forhold

  • Varieret kørsel – både lokal og regional (evt. længere ture)

  • Gode kollegaer og uformel, professionel omgangstone

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og gældende overenskomst

  • Fast bil og moderne materiel

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har gyldigt kørekort kategori CE

  • Har gyldigt EU-chaufførbevis og førerkort (tachografkort)

  • Er mødestabil, ansvarlig og serviceminded

  • Taler og forstår dansk (eller engelsk på rimeligt niveau)

  • Har erfaring med lastbilkørsel
    (gerne både distributions- og landevejskørsel)

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og har styr på dokumentation og kørselsregistrering

Arbejdssted

Vores base ligger i Brøndby (Storkøbenhavn).

Ansøgning

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Så send din ansøgning og evt. CV til:

Dag-group@outlook.dk

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende.

----/-/-/-/English/-/-/-/--/--/-/

Truck Driver – Mixed Transport

Dag Log – Brøndby (Greater Copenhagen)

Dag Log is seeking 5 new reliable and professional truck driver for mixed transport operations. The position is a key part of our daily logistics operations, where punctuality, quality, and professional customer interaction are essential.

As a driver at Dag Log, you will handle a variety of transport tasks, including distribution, pickup and delivery, and potentially longer-distance routes, depending on your qualifications and operational needs.

Key responsibilities

  • Execution of planned transport assignments with a strong focus on on-time delivery and high service quality

  • Distribution, pickup, and delivery of goods

  • Ensuring correct documentation and transport records

  • Professional interaction with customers and business partners

  • Compliance with all applicable transport legislation and driving/rest regulations

We offer

  • A full-time position with stable and well-organized employment conditions

  • Varied and independent driving assignments

  • Modern vehicles and equipment, including a dedicated truck

  • A professional working environment with skilled and supportive colleagues

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and applicable collective agreements

We expect that you

  • Hold a valid CE driving license

  • Possess a valid EU Driver Qualification Card and digital tachograph card

  • Are reliable, responsible, and well-structured

  • Have experience with truck driving, preferably both distribution and long-distance transport

  • Can work independently and maintain a high level of professionalism

  • Communicate effectively in English (Danish is an advantage)

  • Have a strong focus on safety, quality, and accurate documentation

Work location

The position is based in Brøndby, Greater Copenhagen.

Application

If you are interested in joining a professional and well-established logistics company, please submit your application and CV to:

Dag-group@outlook.dk

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

title: Er du massør med passion for dit fag? Bliv en del af CityFys i Kalundborg! Are you a massage therapist with a passion for your profession? Join CityFys in Kalundborg!
description:
Hos CityFys søger vi en engageret og dygtig massør til vores virksomhedsordninger i Kalundborg – uanset om du er nyuddannet eller har flere års erfaring! Vi er på udkig efter en passioneret massør, der ønsker at arbejde i et udviklende og støttende miljø, hvor du kan gøre en forskel for vores kunder.

Hvorfor CityFys?

Som massør hos CityFys får du stor frihed under ansvar og fleksible arbejdstider, så du kan tilpasse arbejdet efter dit liv. Vi tror på kontinuerlig udvikling og opfordrer dig til at eksperimentere med forskellige massageteknikker, der passer til hver kundes unikke behov. Hos os bliver du en del af vores "lille-STORE-familie" – et team af professionelle behandlere, der arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe den bedste oplevelse for kunderne.

Vi værdsætter både personlig og faglig vækst, og vi skaber et arbejdsmiljø, hvor din passion for at hjælpe andre bliver anerkendt og belønnet.

Hos CityFys er vores mål at være Danmarks bedste arbejdsplads for massører og levere kvalitetsbehandlinger til vores kunder.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Faste og attraktive behandlingsdage i CityFys’ virksomhedsordninger og i egen klinik

  • Mulighed for ekstra vikaropgaver og fleksible timer

  • Gratis og løbende efteruddannelse, herunder kurser i triggerpunkter, ergonomi, stretching og meget mere. Læs om kurserne her: CityFys kurser

  • Fordelagtige vilkår, inklusiv fitness- og sundhedsordning

  • Fleksibel aflønning – enten per faktura eller som dataløn

  • Løbende support og sparring, så du kan udvikle dig i dit tempo

Er du klar til at tage din karriere som massør til næste niveau?

Send din ansøgning via vores hjemmeside: http://cityfys.dk/søg-job/  
Vi tilbyder hurtig tiltrædelse og glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Har du spørgsmål? Ring til os på tlf. 70 200 726.

Om CityFys:
CityFys A/S er Danmarks største leverandør af massageordninger og betjener flere af landets største virksomheder. Vi har været i branchen siden 1999 og driver egne wellnessafdelinger i DGI Huset Herning, DGI Byen København og Water & Wellness Randers.

 

English version:

At CityFys, we are looking for an engaged and skilled masseur for our corporate programs in Kalundborg – whether you're newly graduated or have several years of experience! We are seeking a passionate masseur who wants to work in a supportive and developmental environment where you can make a difference for our clients.

Why CityFys?

As a masseur at CityFys, you’ll have great freedom with responsibility and flexible working hours, allowing you to adapt your work to your life. We believe in continuous development and encourage you to experiment with different massage techniques tailored to each client’s unique needs. With us, you will become part of our "small-BIG family" – a team of professional therapists who work closely together to create the best experience for our clients.

We value both personal and professional growth, and we create a work environment where your passion for helping others is recognized and rewarded.

At CityFys, our goal is to be Denmark's best workplace for masseurs and to deliver high-quality treatments to our clients.

We offer:

  • Fixed and attractive treatment days in CityFys’ corporate programs and in oue own clinic

  • Opportunity for additional substitute work and flexible hours

  • Free and ongoing further education, including courses in trigger points, ergonomics, stretching, and much more. Read about the courses here: CityFys courses

  • Beneficial conditions, including fitness and health plans

  • Flexible compensation – either per invoice or as salary

  • Ongoing support and guidance, allowing you to develop at your own pace

Are you ready to take your career as a masseur to the next level?

Send your application via our website: CityFys Job Postings
We offer quick onboarding and look forward to hearing from you!

Have any questions? Call us at +45 70 200 726.

About CityFys:
CityFys A/S is Denmark's largest provider of massage services and serves some of the country's largest companies. We have been in the industry since 1999 and run our own wellness departments at DGI Huset Herning, DGI Byen Copenhagen, and Water & Wellness Randers.

title: Assisterende køkkenchef til Hotel Scheelsminde
description:
Assisterende Køkkenchef til Scheelsminde - en del af Bühlmann Hotels
- charmerende herregårdshotel tæt på Aalborg centrum

På Hotel Scheelsminde søger vi en ny kollega, som er topmotiveret til at være en del af et kokketeam i udvikling. Ambitionerne og kvalitetsniveauet er højt, og du kommer til at arbejde sammen med dygtige og energiske kolleger, der alle brænder for gastronomi. Vi forventer derfor også, at du har lysten til virkelig at bidrage til, at Restaurant Bühlmann bliver betragtet som en af landsdelens bedste restauranter som bidrager til vores særlige fokus på møder, konferencer og selskaber.

Jobbet indeholder i samspil med vores Køkkenchef bl.a. følgende ansvarsområder:

  • Gastronomi - Sikre den unikke gæsteoplevelse, hvor kvalitet og opmærksomhed på detaljerne er i højsædet.

  • Menu udvikling - Sikre og videreudvikle en spændende og nyskabende menu, der afspejler vores høje gastronomiske standard og følger sæsonens råvarer.

  • Kvalitetskontrol - Sikre, at hver ret, der forlader køkkenet, opfylder vores høje standarder for smag og præsentation.

  • Personaleledelse - Ansættelse, træning og motivation af vores køkkenpersonale igennem synlighed og nærværende ledelse.

  • Råvarekontrol - Ansvarlig for indkøb og lagerstyring af ingredienser og produkter.

  • Budgetstyring - Overvåge og styre køkkenets økonomi og omkostninger.

  • Hygiejne og sikkerhed - Sikre, at alle fødevarestandarder og hygiejneregler overholdes i overensstemmelse med lovgivningen.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Job i en virksomhed med stor erfaring og kendskab til branchen

  • En kvalitetsbevidst arbejdsplads med professionelle ansatte

  • En virksomhed hvor der ikke er langt fra tanke til handling

  • Gode arbejdsforhold og fordelagtige personalerabatter i hele koncernen

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har stor interesse for gastronomi samt relevant ledererfaring

  • Arbejder med stort engagement og fleksibilitet

  • Er en god samarbejdspartner

  • Er udadvendt, nysgerrig og positiv

Lyder det som noget for dig, så ansøg via dette link senest den 30-09-2026

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Hoteldirektør Mike Sthyr på mike.sthyr@buhlmann.dk. Marker emnelinjen ”Assisterende Køkkenchef til Scheelsminde”.

Vi er en del af Bühlmann Hotels

Bühlmann Hotels har flere unikke hoteller i Danmark. Hotelporteføljen byder på urbane city hoteller og ikoniske boutiquehoteller. Selvom alle hotellerne er forskellige og har hver deres unikke særpræg, leverer alle medarbejdere værtskab ud fra de samme værdier:  omhu, fleksibilitet, nærvær, passion og respekt for mennesker og miljø.

Læs mere om vores hoteller på www.buhlmann.dk

title: Autolakerer til Odense
description:
Autolakerer søges til at få ridser og buler til at forsvinde!  

Har du styr på afdækning, slibning og spartling så bilerne står knivskarpe, før de ruller ind i kabinen? Kan du få selv de mest triste biler til at se ud som nye? Så er det dig, vi leder efter! 

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Hertil håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året..

Hvad skal du lave? 

  • Du bliver en del af et team af lakspecialister, der tryller buler og ridser væk. Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.: 
  • Du fixer buler, spartler, sliber og afdækker (sprøjtelakerer), Så bilerne står som nye 
  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 

Hvem er du? 

  • Du er en frisk type med humor, der elsker en god snak med kollegaerne over en kaffepause – men også en, der går op i kvalitet og finish. Vi leder efter dig, der: 
  • Har uddannelse eller erfaring som autolakerer 
  • Kan holde styr på opgaverne, selv når der er travlt 
  • Du evner at strukturere dine opgaver 
  • Har kørekort (B) – så du ikke behøver skubbe bilerne selv 
  • Elsker tempoet i en virksomhed, hvor ingen dage er helt ens 

Hvad får du? 

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer – vi betaler for talent! 
  • Gode kollegaer, der kan deres kram (og deler værkstedshistorier i pauserne) 
  • Markeds bedste redskaber/produkter at arbejde med 
  • Mulighed for udvikling 
  • En arbejdsplads med humor, godt humør og højt til loftet  

 Hvad gør du nu? 

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads! 

Vi holder samtaler løbende, fordi vi vil have den helt rigtige medarbejder med på holdet hurtigst muligt. Men hey – vi ved, at kvalitet tager tid, så vi venter gerne på den rette. 

Hvis du tænker: "Det dér job er som skabt til mig!" – så spild ikke tiden! Send din ansøgning afsted med det samme.  

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com. 

 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte

title: Pizzabager søges til Pizzeria Il Padrino ApS – Pizza Baker Wanted – Join Pizzeria Il Padrino ApS
description:
Pizzabager søges til Pizzeria Il Padrino ApS – autentisk stenovnspizzeria i Roskilde

Adresse: Knud Den Stores Vej 35, 4000 Roskilde

Stillingsbetegnelse: Pizzabager

Arbejdstid: Fuldtid – efter aftale

Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

Om os

title: Rengøring af tandlægeklinik i 4760 Vordingborg
description:
Er det mon dig vi mangler!!!

Vi søger en ny kollega, som kan hjælpe os 3 gange om ugen - det er mandag-onsdag - fredag i 3 timet og 5 min på en tandlægeklinik i Vordingborg.

Jobbet er et "lille job", så du kan med fordel være fleksjobber, gå på en videregående uddannelse, eller blot ønske et lille ekstrajob. Jobbet deles med en kollega, som har de andre dage, hvorfor man skal være indstillet på at afløse denne ved sygdom og ferie. Derudover vil det være en fordel, hvis du også har mulighed for, at hjælpe med afløsning på vores andre klinikker i området.

Der er ikke noget krav om erfaring indenfor rengøring, da jobbet er udførligt beskrevet. Det eneste krav vi stiller er, at du er mødestabil, grundig og har sans for detaljerne, samt behersker dansk i skrift og tale.

Jobbet indebærer affaldshåndtering af lettere afald (pap og papir til container), rengøring af flader, gulve, toiletter, personalerum, gangarealer og klinikker. Bemærk ingen rengøring af tandlægestole.

Klinikken ligger centralt i Vordingborg.

Mødetid er efter klinikkens lukketid, det vil sige at man tidligst kan møde kl 18.30 mandag og kl. 17:30 onsdag samt kl 15:30 fredag. Der er ikke mulighed for morgenrengøring. Den normerede arbejdstid er 3 time 5 min pr. arbejdsdag.

Løn og andre vilkår er ifølge overenskomst.

Vores nuværende medarbejder ønsker at stoppe inden for de næste par uger, ønsker vi opstart hurtigst muligt.

Ansøgning bedes sendt pr. mail til helle@delta-rengoering.dk - noter venligst Vordingborg i overskriften.

title: Vil du lede pædagogikken tæt på børnene i et ambitiøst børnehus?
description:
Når et lille menneske lykkes, mærker du det helt ind i hjertet.

Og når medarbejdere udvikler sig, lykkes med svære opgaver eller finder nye veje i deres praksis, giver det dig den samme følelse.

Forestil dig en helt almindelig tirsdag i vuggestuen.

Et barn står længe og overvejer, om det tør kravle op på den høje skammel ved bordet. Du er tæt på, men ikke for tæt. Du giver plads, tid og opmuntring. Barnet prøver selv. Lykkes. Smilet breder sig.

Lidt senere er du i dialog med en medarbejder om, hvordan dagens rutiner kan skabe endnu bedre deltagelsesmuligheder for børnene. Sammen reflekterer I over praksis, justerer og bliver klogere.

Det er netop samspillet mellem ledelse og pædagogik, der gør denne stilling særlig.

I Farum Nordby Børnehus søger vi en afdelingsleder til vores vuggestue, som ønsker at være tæt på både børn, medarbejdere og den pædagogiske udvikling. Du vil have 20 timer om ugen til ledelsesopgaver og bruge resten af din arbejdstid i praksis sammen med børnene og kollegerne.

Vi tror på, at den stærkeste ledelse opstår, når man leder tæt på kerneopgaven.

Derfor skal du vælge os

Vi tror på, at god pædagogik starter med gode relationer. Ikke kun til børnene, men også til hinanden.

Hos os bliver du en del af et hus, hvor faglige refleksioner, sparring og ærlige dialoger er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vi er optagede af, hvordan vi sammen kan skabe de bedste deltagelsesmuligheder for børnene, og vi ved, at det kræver både faglighed, nysgerrighed og mod.

Som afdelingsleder bliver du en central del af dette arbejde. Du skal understøtte medarbejdernes faglige udvikling, skabe retning og sammenhæng i hverdagen og samtidig være en aktiv del af det pædagogiske arbejde med børnene.

Vi ønsker ikke at håndtere eller servicere børn gennem dagen. Vi ønsker at invitere dem ind som aktive deltagere i deres eget hverdagsliv.

Derfor ser vi også dagens rutiner som mere end praktiske opgaver. Garderoben, måltidet, bleskiftet og middagsluren er betydningsfulde pædagogiske rum, hvor relationer styrkes, selvstændighed udvikles, og børn oplever mestring.

Som leder er du med til at fastholde dette fokus og omsætte vores værdier til praksis sammen med medarbejderne.

Samtidigt arbejder vi i en kultur præget af tillid, humor og fælles ansvar. Vi hjælper hinanden, deler vores erfaringer og tror på, at arbejdsglæde opstår, når mennesker føler sig set, hørt og værdsat.

Vi leder efter dig, som

Måske har du allerede ledererfaring. Måske er du en erfaren pædagog, der er klar til at tage næste skridt og har lyst til at udvikle dig som leder.

Det vigtigste er, at du:

  • Er uddannet pædagog.
  • Har lyst til at kombinere ledelse og pædagogisk praksis.
  • Kan skabe retning, overblik og følgeskab gennem tillidsfulde relationer.
  • Ser børn som kompetente deltagere med egne perspektiver.
  • Er optaget af at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder frem for løsninger på børnenes vegne.
  • Kan understøtte medarbejderes faglige refleksion og udvikling.
  • Har mod til at gå nysgerrigt og anerkendende ind i faglige dialoger.
  • Kan møde både børn, forældre og medarbejdere med nærvær, respekt og tydelighed.
  • Bidrager positivt til fællesskabet med humor, energi og ansvarlighed.

Hos os får du

  • En afvekslende stilling med 20 timers ledelse og resten af tiden i praksis med børnene.
  • Mulighed for at præge udviklingen af vuggestuens faglige og pædagogiske retning.
  • Et stærkt arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi lykkes sammen.
  • Medarbejdere, der prioriterer sparring, refleksion og faglig udvikling.
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor tillid vægtes højere end kontrol.
  • En kultur præget af omsorg, humor og respekt.
  • Tæt kontakt til kerneopgaven og børnenes hverdag.
  • Et børnesyn, hvor fællesskab, deltagelse og medbestemmelse er fundamentet for vores arbejde.
  • Mulighed for ledelsesmæssig sparring og udvikling.
  • Forberedelses- og ledelsestid indlagt i arbejdstiden.

Hvis du kan se dig selv her

Så håber vi, du har lyst til at blive en del af Farum Nordby Børnehus.

Vi leder ikke blot efter en afdelingsleder. Vi leder efter et menneske, der ønsker at gøre en forskel for både børn og medarbejdere, og som tror på, at den vigtigste ledelse ofte sker tæt på praksis og midt i hverdagens helt almindelige situationer.

Hvis du kan genkende glæden ved at se et barn lykkes, motiveres af at udvikle medarbejdere og har lyst til at stå i spidsen for et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Måske er det dig, der skal være med til at skabe de næste betydningsfulde hverdage i Farum Nordby Børnehus.

Praktisk

Der indhentes referencer fra tidligere ansættelsesforhold, hvis du kommer i betragtning til stillingen.

I Furesø Kommune sker løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og ud fra principperne i Ny Løn.



Et arbejde, der betaler sig - et særligt tillæg

I Furesø Kommune er attraktiv løn, interesse for hinandens faglighed og løbende personlig og faglig udvikling en vigtig del af vores virkelighed. Engagementet i den enkelte har stor betydning for børnenes trivsel, udvikling og læring. I Furesøs mange dagtilbud er forskellighed en styrke, og medarbejderne går gerne nye veje i arbejdet med at styrke udviklingen af den pædagogiske kvalitet med udgangspunkt i den styrkede pædagogiske læreplan.

Den indsats belønner vi med Furesøtillægget, der sikrer et kvalifikationstillæg på 7.000 kr. i nutidskroner årligt til alle fastansatte pædagoger.

Pædagogerne fortæller
I 4 videoer kan du blive klogere på, vi arbejder med at give Furesøs børn de bedst mulige vilkår og muligheder i livet. Se dem på furesoe.dk/blivpædagog

title: Business Development Manager til Danmarks nationale klynge for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed
description:
CenSec – Center for Defence, Space & Security 

Vil du arbejde med at styrke vækst, innovation og internationalisering inden for den danske forsvarssektor? Og være med til at udvikle Danmarks nationale innovations- og erhvervsklynge for aktører inden for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed?   

  

Om stillingen 

CenSecs mission er at være drivkraften bag et stærkt dansk SMV-økosystem, der former fremtidens løsninger inden for forsvar, sikkerhed og rum – og som Business Development Manager kommer du til at spille en vigtig rolle her.   

Du kommer til at arbejde primært med klyngens forsvarsdomæne og med et særligt fokus på droner, autonome enheder og internationalt samarbejde. 

En del af arbejdet udføres på tværs af projekter, hvor du vil få ansvaret for leverancerne heri, som bl.a. indbefatter dialog med industrien.  

Du får til opgave at planlægge og afvikle forskellige klyngeaktiviteter, lige fra mindre netværksmøder til større konferencer. Klyngeaktiviteterne skal hjælpe CenSecs medlemmer med at få ny viden, skabe samarbejde på tværs og øge medlemmernes kommercielle udvikling. Aktiviteterne har både nationalt og internationalt fokus. 

Udover arbejdet med klyngeaktiviteterne får du til opgave at rekruttere nye medlemmer, være kontaktperson for medlemsvirksomheder og deltage i interne udviklingsopgaver- og processer.  

Arbejdet med udvikling af klyngen omfatter også en del administration, opgaver relateret til formidling og kommunikation, samt samarbejde med andre aktører i det forsvarsindustrielle økosystem på både nationalt og europæisk niveau.  

 

Din profil 

Der kan være mange indgangsvinkler til denne stilling, og vi stiller derfor ikke krav til en særlig baggrund. Vigtigst er det at du er en “do’er”, som har vilje og evne til at omsætte input og viden til konkret værdi for vores medlemmer og samarbejdspartnere.

Vi forventer en høj grad af selvstændighed og professionalisme, og at du kan varetage det ansvar og mandat, der medfølger at være ansat i den nationale klyngeorganisation for forsvarsindustrien. 

Derudover er du ekstrovert, kommunikativt stærk, omstillingsparat, fleksibel og taler og skriver engelsk på højt niveau. 

 

Vi tilbyder 

En betydningsfuld rolle i en internationalt anerkendt klyngeorganisation, som skaber innovation, vækst og arbejdspladser. Du får opgaver og muligheder, der medfører faglig og personlig udvikling i et internationalt miljø med ansvar efter evner og ambitioner.  

Dine kollegaer er ambitiøse, humoristiske og uformelle, og trods forskellige ansvarsområder, arbejder vi sammen som et team og hjælper hinanden.  

Vi tilbyder en fleksibel arbejdsuge med to ugentlige fremmødedage på vores kontor i Viborg og hjemmearbejde de resterende ugedage.  

 

Arbejdstid og løn m.m. 

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer ugentligt på funktionærvilkår. 

I forbindelse med projekt- og klyngeaktiviteter i ind- og udland vil der være nogen rejseaktivitet, som altid aftales på forhånd og i god tid. 

Løn efter kvalifikationer og evner til at skabe værdi for CenSec. 

 

Læs mere om CenSec her: www.censec.dk  

 

Om CenSec 

CenSec er Danmarks nationale klynge for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed.  

Som national klynge er vores mandat at samle og styrke hele økosystemet, heriblandt virksomheder, videninstitutioner og myndigheder. 

Vi har en dyb forståelse af økosystemet og en dybdegående viden om vores medlemmer. Vores ambition er at være et omdrejningspunkt hvor alle aktører ser os som den primære drivkraft til at fremme samarbejde på tværs og øge innovation i industrien.  
  
Vi er en tillidsbaseret og stærk medlemsorganisation. Siden 2004 har vi arbejdet for at styrke netværk, samarbejds- og forretningsmuligheder på tværs af sektorer og grænser, gennem facilitering af nationale og internationale netværksaktiviteter.  
  
CenSec – skaber innovation, vækst og robusthed for Danmark.  

  

Ansøgning 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kontakt venligst Anders Laustsen, på tlf. 52 13 15 42 eller skriv til anders@censec.dk  

Vi ser frem til at modtage din motiverede ansøgning og CV til samme mailadresse snarest muligt og senest den 27. september 2026. 

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes gennemført løbende med henblik på ansættelse hurtigst muligt. Vi forbeholder os ret til at ansætte før deadline, hvis vi finder den rette kandidat.

title: HVAC Design Engineer - Offshore Substations; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, PL - Gdynia
description:
Are you a Mechanical Engineer with HVAC design experience and a passion for creating robust technical solutions? Do you want to design HVAC systems for offshore substations supporting some of the world's largest renewable energy projects? Then this could be your next opportunity.

Your Position

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Mechanical Engineer with experience in HVAC system design to strengthen our HVAC team.

In your new position as HVAC Engineer in the Renewables division, you will join our experienced Mechanical & HVAC team. You will design and engineer HVAC systems for offshore substations and work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, clients, suppliers, procurement, fabrication yards and commissioning teams.

You will contribute throughout the project lifecycle, from concept and tender work through detailed design, procurement, construction support and commissioning. Your work will help create robust, safe and efficient HVAC solutions for complex offshore installations.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be either Esbjerg, Nordhavn or Gdynia. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

In this role, you will primarily work on EPCI (Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Installation) contracts for offshore substation projects.

Typical responsibilities include developing HVAC design solutions and technical documentation for offshore substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Design, Engineering & System Integration: Designing ventilation, cooling, heating and pressurization systems, including calculations and equipment sizing.
  • Developing HVAC philosophies, specifications, diagrams, technical requisitions and other project documentation.
  • Compliance, HSE & Quality Assurance: Ensure full compliance with applicable standards, codes, and regulatory requirements, while supporting and adhering to health, safety, and environmental standards in all activities throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Specifying HVAC equipment and supporting procurement, bid evaluation, vendor follow-up and document review.
  • Coordinating technical interfaces with electrical, structural, piping, fire protection and control system disciplines, and participating in client meetings and design reviews.
  • Supporting fabrication, testing and commissioning activities, including FATs, SATs and site support when required, while adhering to health, safety and environmental standards.

Your profile & qualifications

We are looking for a structured and solution-oriented Mechanical Engineer who is passionate about HVAC design and wants to make a personal contribution to offshore renewable energy projects. You collaborate effectively across disciplines, communicate clearly and take ownership of your engineering deliverables.
We are looking for an outgoing and positive professional who is passionate about renewable energy and wants to leave their personal mark on it. You have a proactive and organised approach to your work and are eager to help innovate the future of sustainable solutions

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline.
  • Experience with HVAC engineering and design, preferably from industrial, marine, energy or offshore projects.
  • Knowledge of ventilation, cooling, refrigeration, heating and pressurization systems, including DX and water-based cooling solutions.
  • Experience with technical documentation, equipment specifications and coordination in multidisciplinary EPC projects; offshore substation, offshore wind, marine or industrial plant experience is considered a strong advantage.
  • Professional English communication skills and a strong commitment to teamwork, quality and safety.
  • A strong focus on quality and safety, demonstrated through attention to detail and adherence to HSE requirements.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
For questions, contact Rafid Kajo, Manager, Mechanical & HVAC, at +45 7916 6867 or +45 3016 6613

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Senior Analyst International Accountability Platform for Belarus
description:
Are you an experienced international justice analyst motivated by the opportunity to turn complex information and evidence of violations of international law in Belarus into meaningful action for accountability?

Then DIGNITY can offer you an exciting opportunity as Senior Analyst of the International Accountability Platform for Belarus (IAPB). Join a highly committed international team and play a meaningful role in advancing international justice and accountability. You will enjoy genuine responsibility, be able to shape impactful work, and be part of a supportive, collaborative culture—whether working remotely or from the office.

The IAPB was created in March 2021 as a consortium of Belarusian and international human rights organisations who joined forces to collect, verify, preserve and analyse evidence of violations of international criminal law and international human rights law allegedly committed by Belarusian authorities since 2020. To this end, the platform directly supports national criminal justice authorities and international accountability mechanisms by providing information and evidence. The IAPB’s objective is to achieve accountability of perpetrators and enable redress for the victims. Its operations were recently extended until end of September 2029.

DIGNITY, as the lead organisation of the consortium, hosts the IAPB’s Secretariat within which the position is located.

Since 1982, DIGNITY has worked for a world free of torture and violence. We are a human rights and development organisation that also runs a rehabilitation clinic in Denmark. We prevent torture and violence, treat traumatized victims, and document serious human rights violations so that those responsible can be held accountable.


About the position

As Senior Analyst your focus will be to ensure that evidence is gathered in line with international standards; that timely and high-quality responses to requests by national and international accountability mechanisms are drafted, involving structuring, drafting and reviewing of submissions and analytical briefs; and that the work of the IAPB’s analysts and open-source researchers is well coordinated.

Your primary tasks are:

  • Overseeing the consolidation and analysis of information and evidence gathered by IAPB’s partners and the secretariat team;
  • Strategic planning as well as overseeing the IAPB’s analytical work to support criminal justice authorities and other accountability bodies, in close coordination with the Senior Legal Consultant;
  • Drafting, reviewing and editing of analytical briefs and legal memos for submission to criminal justice authorities and other accountability bodies;
  • Supervising and coordinating the work conducted by analysts and consultants, including setting priorities/tasks and ensuring high standards of work, in close coordination with the Legal Advisor.
  • Cooperating with prosecution authorities and international mechanisms.
  • Other reasonable duties corresponding to ability and training.

The position is expected to include up to 25 days of travel abroad per year.

We offer you:

  • The opportunity to work as part of a highly committed international team of skilled and experienced colleagues, united by a strong sense of purpose and a collaborative team spirit that has been successfully fostered across a remote working environment.
  • The chance to make a tangible contribution to international justice, supporting work that can have concrete, real-world impact for accountability.
  • A high degree of responsibility and meaningful involvement, with the opportunity to shape the work of the platform.
  • A stimulating and purpose-driven working environment, offering opportunities to engage with complex and international criminal law and accountability issues.
  • A supportive and collegial culture, where knowledge-sharing, mutual respect and constructive collaboration are valued.
  • The flexibility of an office environment or remote working environment, combined with an established culture of communication, collaboration and connection across the team.


Skills

We expect you to hold a university degree in law (at undergraduate or postgraduate level), preferably with a specialisation in international criminal law.

We also expect that you have:

  • A minimum of 10 years of demonstrated practical professional experience in the documentation of violations of international law, preferably in the context of international criminal law. This experience should include substantial hands-on investigative or documentation work and not be primarily academic in nature.
  • A minimum of 5 years analytical and investigative experience in relation to violations of international criminal law, in particular crimes against humanity, including the assessment and analysis of relevant facts, evidence, and applicable legal frameworks.
  • Demonstrated legal drafting skills, including experience in conceptualising, structuring and drafting of submissions to national and international human rights and accountability bodies.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating and overseeing the work of a team of analysts, including allocating and reviewing work and providing substantive guidance to members of the IAPB team in a remote working environment.
  • Experience with universal and extra-territorial jurisdiction cases.
  • Demonstrated experience liaising with criminal justice stakeholders, including national and/or international accountability bodies.
  • Experience representing an organisation at external events, including conferences or other forums, with the confidence to speak to a range of audiences.
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English.
  • Fluency in Russian and/or Belarusian will be given particular weight in the selection process.
  • Direct experience interviewing survivors and witnesses is desirable.

It is also important that you have:

  • Excellent communication skills, and the ability to communicate effectively with different target audiences.
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Strong organisational and inter-personal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in an inter-disciplinary environment and across different cultures.
  • Ability to work across a broad portfolio, manage complex workload and be responsive to evolving demands.
  • Cultural and context sensitivity, high ethical standards, and diplomatic skills.
  • and that you are resourceful, creative, collegial, empathic, and respectful.


Terms of employment

The position is placed in the Secretariat of the International Accountability Platform for Belarus (IAPB), of which DIGNITY is the lead organisation. The IAPB is managed by the Head of the Platform and Dignity’s Director of the Prevention & Accountability Department.

The position is placed in Dignity’s head office in Copenhagen (Bryggervangen 55, 2100 Kbh. Ø), but we alternatively offer an employer of record (EoR) solution if you are based in another EU member state. Please note that the position will not be filled on a consultancy basis.

The employment is based on the Danish collective agreement for academics in the Danish State, and the salary level is based on skills and relevant experience and within a range of DKK 50-52.500 (gross, monthly) + pension (18,07%). If you are offered an EoR solution, the salary will depend on comparable positions and terms of employment in the host country.

Expected entry is 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter; the position is currently envisaged until 30 September 2029.


More info

Further information about the position can be obtained by contacting the IAPB Secretariat at iapb@dignity.dk.

The application consisting of CV, letter of motivation, diploma and other documents if relevant are submitted via the link no later than 27 September 2026.

We expect to hold interviews on 15-16 October 2026 digitally, and possibly also a second round of interviews on 20-21 October 2026, which will also take place digitally.

You can read about DIGNITY's processing of your personal data in our privacy policy, which you can find here: https://www.dignity.dk/privatlivspolitik/

The IAPB is composed of two Belarusian co-lead organisations, Human Rights Center Viasna and International Committee for the Investigation of Torture in Belarus, and its lead organisation DIGNITY – Danish Institute against Torture.

Since its establishment, it has continued to expand its evidence base and analytical outputs, collecting testimonies of some 2,900 victims and witnesses, over 38,000 victim-related documents and over 2.1 million open-source items, including extensive audiovisual and textual materials.

Cooperation with accountability mechanisms contributed to the decision of the Office of the Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court to open an investigation into crimes against humanity related to the Lithuania/Belarus situation. Overall, by June 2026, the Platform had responded to 14 requests from national jurisdictions and prepared 13 submissions to multiple international mechanisms.

As part of its survivor-centred approach, so far it has provided mental health and psychosocial support to 850 beneficiaries.

Beyond documentation and support activities, the IAPB promotes accountability pathways for Belarus, outlined in its report “Paths to Accountability for Belarus”.

title: Postdoc in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows
description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows

We seek a bioinformatician to develop computational workflows to analyze large-scale microbiome multi-omics data in multiple projects studying human and animal health, including the consortium project PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net) and EU Horizon 2020 project MICROB-PREDICT (https://microb-predict.eu/). We strive to implement efficient and scalable workflows to analyze and integrate these data derived from metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, and metaproteomics in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. We have developed the MIntO package (https://github.com/arumugamlab/MIntO) that integrates microbiome metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data. Our ambition is to develop new workflows that expand MIntO’s features (e.g., novel analysis types) as well as datatypes (e.g., metabolomic data).

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding workflows in our current MIntO pipeline, while also having a chance to create your own novel workflows.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing projects within these consortia and other projects in the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia, to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below:

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

The Postdoc fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers with a background in basic science. We are particularly interested in candidates with solid experience in analyzing large volumes of next-generation sequencing data, who are aware of challenges in scalability and efficiency

Required qualifications:

  • PhD in bioinformatics or biology with strong experience in software development.

  • Academic preparation as well as experience in biological statistics.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or R.

  • Experience with bioinformatics workflow environments such as snakemake, NextFlow or CWL.

  • Experience in analyzing next-generation sequencing datasets.

  • Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

  • Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

  • Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred, but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

  • Basic understanding of disease biology and/or microbiology.

  • Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

  • Experience in handling multi-omics data, including metabolomics and proteomics.

  • Experience in distributed and cloud computing technologies.

  • Experience in supervising other researchers at different levels.

  • International mobility

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision – We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Group Leader Mani Arumugam, Department of Clinical Research, e-mail: arumugam@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 23649552 or Head of Department at the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477 

Application deadline

September 23, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science.

We seek a data scientist to derive insights from host-microbiome multi-omics data in multiple consortium projects studying human and animal health, including GALAXY/MicrobLiver studying liver fibrosis (https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/galaxy), MICROB-PREDICT studying late-stage liver cirrhosis (https://microb-predict.eu/), and PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net). The current state-of-the-art for multi-omics integration and interpretation leaves much to be desired. Fortunately, our ongoing work leveraging a deep learning approach (autoencoders) integrates multi-omics data and generates biologically relevant insights using a biologically informed machine learning framework. Our ambition is to strengthen and expand this research direction into graph-based approaches such as graph neural networks.

title: Restaurationsmanager
description:
Restaurationsmanager

Dit Smørrebrød i Skagen er en travl virksomhed i rivende udvikling. 
Vores kendetegn er traditionelt dansk smørrebrød til Skawboer og turister – uden dikkedarer.
Godt gammeldags smørrebrød, klassiske frokost retter samt “Mormor mad” på aftenmenuen, hvor det er lavet fra bunden med friske råvarer – og ”salt, peber og kærlighed”, råvarer af bedste kvalitet samt vores kvalitet og service er ALTID i top.

Vores restaurant emmer af afslappet stemning og maden indtages i hyggelig gammel dansk atmosfære med rød og hvidternede duge. Skagens hyggeligste frokost og aftens restaurant. 

Vi har stor ansvarsfølelse for vores ansatte - vi værdsætter gensidig tillid. Vi løser vores opgaver i fællesskab ved at serverer godt gedigent mad i en afslappet atmosfære, som er fyldt med grin og glæde for så vel ansatte som for vores gæster.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver
Som restaurantansvarlig får du en central rolle i den daglige drift, hvor du blandt andet skal:

•    Lede og koordinere restaurantteamet under vagterne
•    Fordele arbejdsopgaver og administrere personalets pauser
•    Sikre en effektiv og velfungerende service
•    Tage godt imod gæsterne og hjælpe til, hvor der er behov
•    Overvåge servicekvaliteten og sikre høj kundetilfredshed
•    Håndtere gæstespørgsmål og eventuelle reklamationer professionelt
•    Koordinere samarbejdet mellem køkken og serveringspersonale
•    Åbne og/eller lukke restauranten samt foretage kasseafstemning
•    Sikre, at restauranten altid fremstår ren, organiseret og klar til service
•    Medvirke til oplæring af nye medarbejdere
•    Løse udfordringer løbende under vagten
•    Stå for varebestilling og lagerstyring

Vi forestiller os, at du

•    Har erfaring fra restaurant- eller servicebranchen
•    Trives med ansvar og kan bevare overblikket i travle perioder
•    Er serviceminded, imødekommende og løsningsorienteret
•    Kan motivere og skabe et godt samarbejde blandt kollegaerne
•    Har fokus på kvalitet og gæsteoplevelser

Vi tilbyder

•    Helårsansættelse
•    Mulighed for bolig
•    Et uhøjtideligt arbejdsmiljø med plads til humor
•    Afslappet omgangstone og godt humør i hverdagen
•    Nogle af de gladeste gæster, fordi vi laver god mad
•    Gode kollegaer, hvor vi løfter i fællesskab
•    En hektisk, spændende og sjov højsæson
•    Attraktiv løn efter kvalifikationer

Arbejdstid i tidsrummet mellem kl. 10.00 og 21.00, på alle ugens dage

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning og CV til smag@smag-toscana.dk

Ansøgning mærkes i emnefeltet: Restaurationsmanager

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig

---------------------------------------------------------------

Restaurant Manager

Dit Smørrebrød in Skagen is a busy restaurant experiencing strong growth.
We are known for serving traditional Danish open sandwiches (smørrebrød) to both local residents and tourists. We pride ourselves on good old-fashioned ‘smørrebrød’, classic lunch dishes, and traditional home-style cooking on our evening menu. Everything is prepared from scratch using fresh ingredients, seasoned with "salt, pepper and love". We use only the finest quality produce, and our standards of food quality and customer service are always second to none.

Our restaurant offers a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere, where guests enjoy their meals surrounded by cosy Danish charm, complete with red-and-white checked tablecloths. We are proud to be one of Skagen's most inviting lunch and dinner restaurants.

We take great responsibility for the wellbeing of our employees and place a high value on mutual trust. We work together as a team to serve honest, wholesome food in a relaxed environment for both our staff and our guests.

Your Key Responsibilities

As Restaurant Manager, you will play a central role in the daily operation of the restaurant.
 Your responsibilities will include:
•    Leading and coordinating the restaurant team during service
•    Allocating tasks and managing staff breaks
•    Ensuring efficient and smooth-running service
•    Welcoming guests and assisting wherever needed
•    Monitoring service quality and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction
•    Handling guest enquiries and any complaints professionally
•    Coordinating communication and cooperation between the kitchen and front-of-house teams
•    Opening and/or closing the restaurant, including cash reconciliation
•    Ensuring the restaurant is always clean, organized, and ready for service
•    Assisting with the training and onboarding of new employees
•    Resolving operational challenges as they arise during service
•    Managing stock orders and inventory control

About You

We are looking for someone who:
•    Has experience within the restaurant, hospitality, or service industry
•    Thrives on responsibility and remains calm under pressure during busy periods
•    Is service-minded, approachable, and solution-oriented
•    Can motivate colleagues and foster a positive team environment
•    Has a strong focus on quality and guest experience

We Offer

•    Permanent, year-round employment
•    Accommodation available
•    An informal working environment with plenty of room for good spirits
•    A relaxed workplace culture with a positive atmosphere
•    Some of the happiest guests around, because we serve great food
•    Supportive colleagues who work together as a team
•    A busy, exciting, and enjoyable high season
•    Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience

Working Hours
Working hours will be scheduled between 10:00 am and 9:00 pm, seven days a week.

Interested?
If this sounds like the opportunity for you, please send your application and CV to smag@smag-toscana.dk

Subject line: Restaurant Manager

title: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

·         Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
·         Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
·         General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

·         Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
·         Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
·         Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
·         Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
·         Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
·         Not be afraid of getting dirty
·         Understand and speak English
·         Be an EU citizen
 
Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
·         Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
·         Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
·         Start date: as soon as possible
·         Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
·         Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max
 
Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

title: Senior Service Engineer, High Voltage; DK - Esbjerg
description:
Do you have a passion for renewable energy and a sharp eye for technical details? Are you excited about managing projects from start to finish but also want to use your technical skillset and knowhow hands-on offshore? If so, we want to hear from you!

Your position 

As our new Senior Service Engineer in the Renewable division, you will be a valuable member of the Medium and High Voltage Service team, whose mission is to execute medium- and high-voltage service projects across disciplines for offshore assets, e.g. OSS, rigs, and WTGs. You will have the chance to drive all aspects of the project process, from initial client inquiries to final execution. Moreover, this role provides an exciting opportunity for you to make a lasting impact on the projects you work on and advance your professional development.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be our Global HQ in Esbjerg, and you should live within daily driving distance of Esbjerg. The position is full-time, and up to 90 travel days per year should be expected.
“You will be part of a team of fantastic and competent colleagues who prioritise teamwork and a ‘winning as a team’ mentality. Our team values a flexible work atmosphere with an emphasis on balancing work and personal life, as well as opportunities for professional growth. In this role, you will have great opportunities to bring your own ideas to the table and play a key role in shaping our projects and services.”                                                              – Christian Poulsen, Head of MV & HV Service

Your tasks & responsibilities 

As a Senior Service Engineer, you will be responsible for managing and executing MV & HV Service projects from a technical perspective in collaboration with cross-functional teams, external partners, and customers. Moreover, you will apply your expertise hands-on by using your specialist knowledge to execute the service. You will be responsible from the initiation and tendering of the project through to delivering a solution and finally executing it offshore. This will involve collaborating with various teams across the organisation and externally.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:
  • You will have end-to-end technical responsibility for specific projects in the MV & HV Service team, from tendering, clarification, and planning to execution.
  • Provide technical assistance and calculations to support projects across the organisation.
  • Perform hands-on offshore special technical testing and troubleshooting.
  • Coordinate and plan work packages for execution, both on- and offshore.

Your profile & qualifications

As a person, you enjoy having a lot of responsibility and thrive in an environment where you communicate daily with many stakeholders. You are driven by completing tasks to the best of your ability and remain in control, even in fast-paced situations. You have a safety-focused mindset and never compromise when it comes to safety on the job. Additionally, you are service-minded and greatly enjoy collaborating with your colleagues.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • An engineering degree or similar qualification within electrical systems.
  • Broad know-how of MV and HV systems and technologies from the offshore wind industry.
  • In-depth knowledge of electrical systems.
  • A proven track record of servicing protection systems for both low voltage and high voltage.
  • Broad knowledge of electrical systems: high, medium, and low voltage.
  • Desire and willingness to travel and perform hands-on onsite work.
  • Fluency in English, written and verbal.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 
So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 

Change. With us. 

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Christian Poulsen, Head of MV & HV Service at +45 2294 4199.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Senior Immersion Engineer
description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The immersion engineering team is looking for a naval architect, maritime engineer or offshore engineer to strengthen the team. Immersion engineering is taking care of all calculations regarding tunnel elements float up (weight analysis, determine ballast concrete and water, longitudinal section forces, floating stability), transfers in basins and harbor (winch operations with or without vessel assistance), mooring of the tunnel elements, transport to offshore location, immersion (including but not limited to dynamic analyses) and the stability of the elements after immersion.

As an Immersion Engineer, you will participate in the team responsible for floating up and/or hoisting the concrete tunnel elements, equipping them in the port and then transporting and installing them at sea. In the first phase you will participate in the preparation of this crucial operation, by making ballast plans e.g.. In the second phase, you will be part of the operational team that does the immersion work, assisting the Immersion Master by giving technical advice.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

  • During the preparatory phase, you are responsible for the ballast plans and float up calculations.

  • You take part in the interface management with other departments within FLC regarding specific parts of the T&I scope

  • You will coordinate part of the design scope between Work Preparations and the design team based in the Netherlands

  • You are involved in the management/operation of Tunnel Control Systems

  • You ensure the conclusions and results from the design documents are correctly taken over in the work method statements, drawings and operation manuals for the Immersion Pontoon specific operations related to the overall transport and immersion scope

  • You liaise with the Marine Warranty Surveyor and contribute to the work procedures, Go/No Go procedures

  • During float up and ballasting you check if the operations stay within boundary conditions and act accordingly

  • During the execution phase, you advise during the transport and installation of the elements. You will be present in the command unit of the immersion pontoons during offshore operations.

  • You will do checks during execution, monitor the immersion process, and have an advisory role to the one in charge of the operation. You are also prepared and ready to deal with contingencies if any might occur

  • After immersion, you will do checks on data to create lessons learned for next operations

Qualifications:

  • You are a qualified naval architect/maritime engineer/offshore engineer with minimum of 7 years experience

  • You have prior experience with immersion of large structures or offshore lifting operations

  • You have a good understanding of stability calculations, mooring calculations and hydrodynamics

  • You are a hands-on problem solver and a decision maker

  • You are a team player with strong communication skills

  • You find it a challenge to work in a international, multi-cultural work-environment in which communication and team spirit is key to success

  • You are fluent in English.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company.

Full time employment with health insurance and lunch arrangement available upon request.

Workplace:

Based in Rødbyhavn.

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible and. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.
