title: Assistant Professor in Thermal Engineering with a Focus on Electronics Cooling in Early Component Design
description:
Fixed-term full-time position (4 years), to be filled from 1 November 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter, at the Aalborg campus.

If you want to contribute to the next generation of high-power electronic components by integrating thermal design directly into the early stages of technology and component development, this position may be the right opportunity for you. We are looking for an Assistant Professor for the Section for Thermal Engineering who can strengthen and further develop our activities within electronics cooling, thermal-fluid modelling, and the integration of thermal design considerations into the early development of future technologies. The position includes research, teaching, and collaboration with both internal and external partners, and you will play an active role in shaping new projects together with colleagues in power electronics. Over time, you are expected to contribute actively to joint research projects and external funding applications that bridge thermal engineering and power electronics in the design of future power modules.

Your work tasks
As an Assistant Professor in the Section for Thermal Engineering, you will join a strong academic environment where research, teaching, and collaboration with external partners are closely linked. The position is based at the Aalborg campus, and you will be part of an international department working within thermal energy systems, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and related areas. In this position, you will work in close collaboration with researchers in power electronics, in particular Associate Professor Stig Munk Nielsen and colleagues in the power electronics and devices environment. Together, you will contribute to the co-design of new power modules where thermal, electrical, and mechanical aspects are considered on equal footing from the earliest design stages.

Your primary research task will be to develop and carry out research in electronics cooling and thermal-fluid design methods, with a particular focus on supporting decision-making in the early stages of technology and component development. This includes thermal-fluid co-design of devices such as IGBTs, MOSFETs, power modules, and other switching devices, where cooling concepts are integrated as explicit design parameters alongside electrical and electromagnetic performance. You will analyse trade-offs between thermal resistance, temperature gradients, power density, lifetime, and reliability, and contribute to the development of thermal and fluid-dynamic models that can be used early in the development process for screening and optimisation before detailed designs are fixed.

Depending on your background, you may initially focus more strongly on modelling, experiments, or design methodology, and gradually expand your activities towards broader thermal-fluid co-design research.

A central part of your work will be to explore and assess advanced cooling concepts for high-power-density systems. This may include integrated cooling solutions, direct-liquid cooling, and two-phase cooling for very high heat fluxes. You will develop and use Computational Fluid Dynamics models in combination with analytical and reduced-order models, and contribute to publishing research results in international journals and conferences. Over time, you are expected to contribute actively to the development of joint research activities and external funding applications together with colleagues from thermal engineering and power electronics.

In parallel with the modelling activities, you will contribute to experimental work at component and module level. This can include development and use of experimental setups for characterisation of thermal resistances and heat fluxes, and validation of cooling concepts at chip, module, and package level. You will work with the interplay between experiments, CFD, and reduced-order models to develop design tools that are sufficiently fast for iterative early-stage development while still capturing the relevant physics.

In teaching, you will contribute to bachelor’s and master’s level courses within thermal engineering, including fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and thermal systems. You will help develop exercises and project activities that draw on realistic engineering problems and demonstrate the interaction between electrical loading, losses, and cooling solutions. You will supervise project and thesis students working on thermal design, cooling concepts, modelling, and experimental investigations. Over time, you are expected to develop a coherent teaching profile linked closely to your research activities and collaborations.

In addition, you will contribute to shared tasks within the section and department, including industry collaboration, study programme development, and supervision of projects associated with externally funded activities.

Your competencies
You have a solid academic background within Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a closely related field, and you hold a PhD degree that qualifies you to work independently with research and research-based teaching.

We recognise that strong candidates may not fulfil every aspect of the profile. Applicants with a strong background in thermal engineering, thermal-fluid modelling, simulation-driven design, or technology development are encouraged to apply, provided they are motivated to further develop competences in electronics cooling and interdisciplinary research.

It is essential that you can document strong competences in flow simulations and thermal modelling, including model development. You have experience using Computational Fluid Dynamics and thermal models as tools to support design and development decisions, rather than solely as post-design analysis tools. You are comfortable working with software environments such as Ansys and OpenFOAM and are motivated to further develop and apply these tools in the context of advanced thermal systems and electronic components.

Prior experience within electronics cooling, component design, thermal management, or related technology development activities will be considered an advantage, but applicants from adjacent fields with strong thermal-fluid competences are also encouraged to apply. Experience from research and development activities, either in academia or industry, including participation in technology development projects and collaboration across disciplines, will likewise be considered an advantage.

Experience with experimental methods in thermal and fluid mechanics, including data analysis, uncertainty estimation, and model validation, is desirable. Familiarity with optical measurement techniques in fluid mechanics and heat transfer will be particularly relevant, as you may contribute to laboratory teaching and research activities.

You are able to reason across scales, from components to systems, and you understand when models must be highly detailed and when lightweight approaches are needed to support efficient development processes.

You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and orally, and are willing to engage with students, colleagues, and external partners in an international environment. Since part of the teaching and industrial collaboration takes place in Danish, you are expected to be able to supervise students in Danish within two years of employment.

As a colleague, you are motivated by interdisciplinary collaboration and enjoy working at the interface between different engineering disciplines, where modelling, experiments, and design considerations must be integrated to develop effective solutions. You bring strong analytical skills, an interest in both modelling and experiments, and a collaborative mindset. You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, and contribute positively to the academic environment.

Who we are
AAU Energy is an research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real world energy challenges. 

Aalborg University has been ranked as the best university in Europe within energy research and is among the very best universities worldwide in this field. At AAU Energy you will be part of a top international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges such as the green transition and future energy systems. 

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and with diverse national and disciplinary backgrounds, which creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as working language in both research and teaching, which supports the integration of international colleagues. 

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.  

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support  

Qualification requirements 
Appointment as assistant professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level. The research potential of each applicant will be emphasized in the overall assessment.

How to apply  
Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications.
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design, The Faculty of Engineering and Science and The Faculty of Medicine. 
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment. 

Do you have any questions? 
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

 Further information 
Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities (in Danish). 

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (only in Danish) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities (only in Danish). 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: Assistant, Tenure-Track Assistant, and Associate Professorships in Software Engineering and Software Technology
description:
SDU Centre for Software Technology in Vejle, part of the Software Engineering units at SDU situated at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invite applications for one or more positions within software engineering and software technology. The positions are open from beginning of 2027, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates. 

The application deadline is September 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

What we offer

With a position at SDU, you will:

  • be part of one of our dynamic research centres with both a national and international profile, while working in areas of tremendous potential and societal relevance;

  • join collaborations across the university, as well as with national, international, and industrial research partners;

  • help establish joint innovation projects in close collaboration with industry and the local society;

  • help build up the research and educational environment;

  • contribute to the teaching programmes in Software Engineering at the highest level for undergraduate and graduate students at SDU;

  • join a harmonious workplace environment that is conducive to productivity, promotes creativity, and rewards and recognizes individuals and group achievement;

  • have the opportunity to live and work in one of the happiest countries in the world that also offers excellent and free health and education systems.

 

What we expect

The focus of the SDU Centre for Software Technology is research and education in software engineering, interactive technology and artificial intelligence. We see these areas complementing each other to make way for the engineering of the next generation of reliable, intelligent and interactive software solutions. We are particularly interested in software operated in real life, systems that adapt at runtime, span embedded devices, edge infrastructure and the cloud, that people work with and trust, and that increasingly answer to regulation. This includes understanding how AI technologies and data-informed software development with a human-centred perspective can change the engineering of products and software infrastructures.

The positions are open in any of the software engineering and software technology research areas of interest to the centres, which include:

  • AI for Software Engineering and Software Engineering for AI

  • Software Architecture and Design, including Architecting for AI Systems and AI-assisted Architecting

  • LLM-based, Agentic, and Multi-agent Software Systems

  • Human-AI collaboration in Software Development

  • Software Engineering for Physical AI and Embodied Systems

  • Self-Adaptive and Autonomous Software Systems

  • AI Orchestration and Infrastructure for AI Compute Offloading

  • Software Engineering for Embedded, Cyber-Physical and IoT-Edge-Cloud Systems

  • Governance, Compliance and Accountability of AI-Enabled Software

  • Human-Centred and Socio-Technical Software Engineering

  • Software Testing and Quality Assurance

  • Software Operation, Evolution, Maintenance, Recovery and Modernization

  • Software Reliability Engineering

  • Empirical Software Engineering

  • Requirements Engineering, Specification, and Modelling

 

Who we are looking for

We are looking for candidates who have demonstrated research excellence appropriate to their career stage, who show a clear path towards an independent and internationally recognised research programme, and who are able and willing to contribute to competitive national and international funding applications. We also expect an interest in working across disciplines, in supervising students and junior researchers, and in teaching and advising in software engineering at all levels.

We expect applicants to hold a PhD in software engineering, computer science or a closely related discipline, completed before the application deadline. 

For the tenure-track assistant professor positions we expect at least one year of research experience beyond the PhD, gained in academia, at a research institute or in industry. Applicants must demonstrate a higher level of achievement in research and related professional activities than generally expected of assistant professor applicants, as well as the potential to attain international research excellence within their field and meet the criteria for employment as an associate professor during the tenure track assistant professorship. 

For the associate professor positions we expect a research and teaching record corresponding to several years of independent work after the PhD, including documented teaching and supervision experience.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who publish in leading venues in the field, such as ICSE, FSE, ASE, ICSA, ECSA, MLSys, DATE, RE, SEAMS, ICSME, SANER, MODELS, ESEM, ICPE and CAiSE, EICS; and in journals such as TSE, TOSEM, EMSE, JSS, IST and IEEE Software.

Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Danish is not a requirement, and successful applicants will be offered Danish language courses.

 

Workplace description

The University of Southern Denmark

The University of Southern Denmark is one of the youngest universities in Denmark, founded in 1966. The university is founded around the goal of providing the right knowledge at the right time to support society. The university targets major, complex societal problems of a cross-disciplinary nature such as climate, welfare, health and technology, tackling these in collaboration across faculties.

The Faculty of Engineering

The Faculty of Engineering is driven by the urge to create value for and with society, by curiosity and by the will to create that which only a few could imagine would be possible. Through research, education and collaboration, it is the ambition of the faculty to nurture talent, address challenges, create possibilities, and promote sustainable development. The faculty is strongly engaged with national and international industries and organizations over a broad range of technical domains.

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The department is the 2nd largest department at SDU, with more than 230 staff members and 1500 students. The institute has over the last decades expanded its activities in interactive technologies, artificial intelligence, and software engineering including building several strong research centres at the SDU campuses in Odense and Sønderborg and with the new centre also in Vejle. Thereby, the institute today covers a wide range of areas in robotics, software, AI, and applied informatics.

 

Curious?

If you are interested in learning more about the position, please contact:

  • Torben Worm (Head of Centres): tow@mmmi.sdu.dk

  • Mikkel Baun Kjærgaard (Vice-Head of Centres): mbkj@mmmi.sdu.dk

  • Mahyar Tourchi Moghaddam (Associate Professor): mtmo@mmmi.sdu.dk

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application procedure

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

  • Cover letter.

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original and official English translation).

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Up to five most relevant publications to the position.

  • A research statement.

  • For assistant professor applicants: Summary and documentation of experience in teaching

  • For associate professor applicants: Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Up to three reference letters may be included (optional).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included (optional).

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is September 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Tenure Track at the Faculty of Engineering, SDU
The Faculty of Engineering at SDU offers an attractive tenure track programme aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area.

Candidates enter at the assistant professor level and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position as associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee.  

This evaluation is based on an overall assessment of the candidate's academic achievements and potential. Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented ability to develop an independent and internationally recognized research profile, deliver high-quality teaching and supervision, contribute actively to the academic community, and demonstrate the potential to secure competitive external research funding and build an ambitious research programme. The evaluation may also consider the candidate's contributions to the strategic and organizational development of the department, including a willingness to engage in academic leadership and administrative responsibilities.

As part of the tenure-track programme, the Assistant Professor is expected to complete SDU's Lecturer Training Programme before the evaluation, unless an equivalent university-level programme has already been completed at another institution.

The programme includes annual performance reviews, a midterm evaluation by an expert panel, and a final academic assessment. If the final assessment is positive, the candidate will progress to a permanent position as associate professor. If the final evaluation is negative, the assistant professor may request one additional assessment within the last six months of employment. The tenure track period may be extended in connection with maternity, paternity, or adoption leave.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. 

Appointment as a tenure track assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 4-year period, with guaranteed assessment for a permanent position as associate professor during the final year of employment.

Appointment as an associate professor is permanent.

Employment requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment, as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position level. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state included the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor, tenure track assistant professor, or associate professor as described therein. 

During employment at assistant professor level (incl. tenure track), the candidate will complete the Lecturer Training Programme.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

description:
Full-time, primarily onsite position in Tallinn. We welcome applications from both strong junior and mid-level Systems Engineers. Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

Work tasks: The Systems Engineer will support the definition, coordination, integration, verification and delivery of Golbriak Space’s optical communication systems.

* Meaningful technical ownership across requirements management, system integration, verification and engineering coordination * The opportunity to work across mechanical, optical, electronic, software, manufacturing and testing disciplines * Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team * The opportunity to develop your expertise in systems engineering, optical communications, telecommunications and aerospace * The ability to contribute to technical decisions, engineering processes and ways of working as the company grows * A gross monthly salary of €2100–€3000, depending on experience, skills and expected level of responsibility * Relocation support to Estonia if required * Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex systems as a whole. The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and willing to take ownership. They should be able to coordinate multiple technical activities and priorities simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills are required, together with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly. The company’s working language is English, so professional working proficiency in English is required. The candidate must be willing to work primarily onsite in Tallinn and be comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve.

title: Inglise keele huviringi juhendaja/õpetaja
description:
Inglise keele õpetaja huviringi lastele

Tööülesanded: Õpetaja ülesanne on 4-9 aastastele lastele mängulise huviringi tunni ettevalmistamine ning seeläbi inglise keele õpetamine. Õpetajale on abiks huvikooli õppekava, materjalid, koolitused ja sõbralik töökollektiiv, kellega on võimalik oma rõõme, muresid ja ideid alati arutada.
Ühe huviringi tunni pikkuseks on 40 minutit ning tunnid toimuvad lasteaedades (ja koolides) nii Valgas, Otepääl kui ka selle ümbruses. Tunnid toimuvad vaid nädala sees ning algavad enamasti alates kella kolmest pärastlõunal. Töö paindlik graafik ning väike koormus (1-8 tundi nädalas) sobivad väga hästi kooli või teise töö kõrvalt töötamiseks. Tööülesannete hulka kuuluvad lisaks tunni ettevalmistamisele ja tunni läbiviimisele ka laste kohaloleku märkimine Google'i tabelisse ning tunni kokkuvõtte saatmine lapsevanematele.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meie õpetajad töötavad toetavas ja teineteist hoidvas kollektiivis, kus ükski mure ei jää lahendamata. Korraldame õppeaasta jooksul mitmeid koolitusi esile kerkivatel teemadel ning veedame niisama mõnusalt koos aega.
Õpetajal on vabadus kujundada omanäoline tund! Selleks pakume omalt poolt mahukat õppematerjalide ning -laulude kogumikku, kuid lõpuks kujundab iga õpetaja oma tunnid ise. Kui materjalidest või mõtetest jääb väheks, aitavad tunni ettevalmistusel kaasõpetajad ja huvikooli õppejuht. Pakume osalist ning paindlikku tööaega (1-8 tundi nädalas). Tunnid toimuvad vaid nädala sees ning hakkavad tavaliselt alates kell 15 pärastlõunal. Nii jääb aega kooli või muude tegevuste jaoks. Meie õpetajad teenivad konkureerivat töötasu. Samuti hüvitame transpordikulud nii isikliku auto kui ühistranspordiga sõites. Sõlmime töövõtulepingu.

title: Inglise keele huviringi juhendaja/õpetaja
description:
Inglise keele õpetaja huviringi lastele

Tööülesanded: Õpetaja ülesanne on 4-9 aastastele lastele mängulise huviringi tunni ettevalmistamine ning seeläbi inglise keele õpetamine. Õpetajale on abiks huvikooli õppekava, materjalid, koolitused ja sõbralik töökollektiiv, kellega on võimalik oma rõõme, muresid ja ideid alati arutada.
Ühe huviringi tunni pikkuseks on 40 minutit ning tunnid toimuvad lasteaedades (ja koolides) nii Paides kui ka selle ümbruses. Tunnid toimuvad vaid nädala sees ning algavad enamasti alates kella kolmest pärastlõunal. Töö paindlik graafik ning väike koormus (1-8 tundi nädalas) sobivad väga hästi kooli või teise töö kõrvalt töötamiseks. Tööülesannete hulka kuuluvad lisaks tunni ettevalmistamisele ja tunni läbiviimisele ka laste kohaloleku märkimine Google'i tabelisse ning tunni kokkuvõtte saatmine lapsevanematele.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meie õpetajad töötavad toetavas ja teineteist hoidvas kollektiivis, kus ükski mure ei jää lahendamata. Korraldame õppeaasta jooksul mitmeid koolitusi esile kerkivatel teemadel ning veedame niisama mõnusalt koos aega.
Õpetajal on vabadus kujundada omanäoline tund! Selleks pakume omalt poolt mahukat õppematerjalide ning -laulude kogumikku, kuid lõpuks kujundab iga õpetaja oma tunnid ise. Kui materjalidest või mõtetest jääb väheks, aitavad tunni ettevalmistusel kaasõpetajad ja huvikooli õppejuht. Pakume osalist ning paindlikku tööaega (1-8 tundi nädalas). Tunnid toimuvad vaid nädala sees ning hakkavad tavaliselt alates kella kolmest pärastlõunal. Nii jääb aega kooli või muude tegevuste jaoks. Meie õpetajad teenivad konkureerivat töötasu. Samuti hüvitame transpordikulud nii isikliku auto kui ühistranspordiga sõites.

Õpetajale on abiks huvikooli õppekava, materjalid, koolitused ja sõbralik töökollektiiv, kellega on võimalik oma rõõme, muresid ja ideid alati arutada. Selleks pakume omalt poolt mahukat õppematerjalide ning -laulude kogumikku, kuid lõpuks kujundab iga õpetaja oma tunnid ise. title: Mänguterapeut
description:
Tööülesanded: Sinu töö sisuks on:
- Toetada lapsi läbi mängu nende emotsionaalses, sotsiaalses ja arengulises toimetulekus. - Luua turvaline ja toetav keskkond, kus laps saab mängu kaudu ennast väljendada ja uusi oskusi õppida. - Kasutada erinevaid mängulisi ja loovteraapilisi võtteid vastavalt lapse individuaalsetele vajadustele. - Arendada laste eneseregulatsiooni, suhtlemis- ja sotsiaalseid oskusi; - Planeerida ja läbi viia individuaalseid tegevusi vastavalt rehabilitatsiooniplaanis sätestatud eesmärkidele. - Teha koostööd lapse, tema pere ja teiste rehabilitatsioonimeeskonna liikmetega, vajadusel ka teiste võrgustiku liikmetega. - Dokumenteerida teenuse osutamist ning vajadusel anda sisendit ning tagasisidet lapse arengu ja eesmärkide hindamisse.

Omalt poolt pakume: - Kokkuhoidvat, professionaalset ja vahvat meeskonda.
- Mitmekülgset kliendibaasi. - Võimalust erialaseks arenguks. - Paindlikku tööaega ning võimalust ise oma päeva planeerida. - Mõnusat kontorit Tartu kesklinna lähistel. - Toredaid ühisüritusi!

title: Füsioterapeut
description:
Tööülesanded: Füsioterapeut on spetsialist, kes taastab, säilitab ja arendab kliendi liikumis- ja tegevusvõimet ning tema osalust igapäevaelus.
Füsioteraapia eesmärk, mis saavutatakse koostöös kliendi ja/või tema tugivõrgustikuga, on toetada ja arendada kliendi iseseisvust tema eale vastavates igapäevategevustes, sooviga parandada elukvaliteeti. Füsioterapeut kasutab oma töös klientidega erinevaid sekkumisviise (näit kehalised harjutused ja funktsionaalne treening, manuaalsed tehnikad, erinevaid füüsikalise ravi meetodeid jt). Füsioteraapia ülesanneteks on võimalike tervisekahjustuste ennetamine, liigeste liikuvusulatuse ja lihaste jõu säilitamine või parandamine, häirunud funktsioonide taastamine, kompenseerimine, valu leevendamine. Töö on nii lastega kui ka täiskasvanutega.

Omalt poolt pakume: - toetav ja sõbralik meeskond,
- paindlik töögraafik, - enesetäiendamise võimalusi, - motiveerivat töötasu.

title: Asiantuntijasairaanhoitaja, sisätautien poliklinikka, Vaasan keskussairaala, Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue
description:
Haemme motivoitunutta ja vastuullista kliinisen hoitotyön asiantuntijasairaanhoitajaa Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueelle. Tehtävän sijoituspaikka on aluksi Vaasan keskussairaalan sisätautien poliklinikka, kardiologia.

Meillä saat mahdollisuuden työskennellä itsenäisesti vastaanottotyössä sekä olla osa moniammatillista tiimiä, joka pyrkii tarjoamaan potilailleen parasta mahdollista palvelua ja hoitoa Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueella.

Etsimme sinua,
- jolla on kokemusta itsenäisestä työskentelystä, mutta viihdyt myös tiimityössä
- joka olet innovatiivinen ja kiinnostunut kehittämään terveydenhuollon digitalisaatiota
- jolla on hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja taitoa ohjata potilaita heidän terveyteensä liittyvissä käytännön ja tunne-elämän kysymyksissä
- joka olet aidosti kiinnostunut kehittymään työssäsi ja osallistumaan hoitotyön kehittämiseen
- joka olet joustava ja pystyt työskentelemään ajoittain kiireisessä ja vaativassa työympäristössä.

Tavoitteenamme on tarjota laadukasta hoitoa ja kehittää jatkuvasti toimintatapojamme vastataksemme tulevaisuuden terveydenhuollon tarpeisiin. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!


Kelpoisuusvaatimus:
Terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetussa laissa (559/1994) tarkoitettu laillistettu sairaanhoitaja SEKÄ soveltuva kliiniseen hoitotyöhön suuntautuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto TAI psykiatrialla terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetussa laissa (559/1994) tarkoitettu laillistettu sairaanhoitaja JA Lupa- ja valvontaviraston hyväksymä psykoterapeutin pätevyys TAI soveltuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto.
Hyvä suullinen ja tyydyttävä kirjallinen taito maamme molemmissa kansalliskielissä.

Sovelletaan koeaikaa.

title: Data protection intern
description:
Are you a Master's student in a university or university of applied sciences and want to learn more about data protection? Are you interested in themes such as law, data protection and privacy?

We are looking for a data protection intern to join our team for three months, from October 1st 2026, to December 31st, 2026.

This internship is designed for international students eager to learn Finnish while working. Our goal is to ensure that individuals from diverse language and cultural backgrounds can smoothly work in the city, and learn the language needed in their jobs.

As a data protection intern, you will be working in the data protection team of the Education Division. We support schools, daycare centers, and other education providers in the city with both data protection and privacy related matters.

In this role, you will be working with various tasks, among other things:

- Review of privacy documentation on educational software and applications used by the Education Division
- Date requests: Handling of data requests from data subjects
- Legal case analysis: Going through legal databases and libraries to update our data protection instructions and processes
- Review sections of AI instructions intended for schools

You should have basic Finnish language skills, as the main working language is Finnish, with English used to support your tasks. We will support your Finnish language development throughout the internship and expect you to actively engage in improving your skills in everyday work situations.

You will join a team that values collaboration and mutual support as our key strengths, and we hope you share the same mindset. Our team fosters a psychologically safe environment for learning. Your workplace will be in Kalasatama, situated in our new and modern workspaces next to the metro station.

The salary for this position is 1 880,37€ per month.

Hopefully you like what you've read so far. We would love to hear from you!


Eligibility criteria:

Please note that this data protection intern position is exclusively available to students pursuing their master's degree at a university or university of applied sciences during the employment contract. Relevant fields of study include (but are not limited to) Law and Administration Studies. Previous experience in data protection and knowledge of the education sector will be considered an advantage.


To promote equality and non-discrimination, the City of Helsinki encourages anonymous recruitment, and this recruitment process will be conducted anonymously. The purpose of anonymous recruitment is to focus attention on the applicants professional competence and work experience. Please complete the job application form as usual. When writing your application, ensure that it follows the principles of anonymity. The hiring manager will select candidates for interviews based on an anonymous summary, which does not display the applicants name, age, gender, or native language.

title: Cost Engineer - Merchant, Handling
description:
**Cost Engineer - Merchant, Handling**

An exciting opportunity awaits you as Cost Engineer in our Propulsion and Handling division at Kongsberg Maritime. In this role, you will be a part of the Sales Support team in Merchant Handling business, delivering support to our external and internal customers worldwide during sales projects. The core task of our team is to understand customer requirements and expectations and turn them into solid technical and commercial proposals supporting the sales of anchoring, mooring & towing solutions.

We are looking for a proactive, structured and cooperative person to support key stakeholders in smooth execution of costing processes. You will be working closely with the Product Management, Delivery organization, Supply Chain and our Global Sales to deliver technically robust solutions to our external and internal customers worldwide.

**Key accountabilities**

- Maintain accurate cost data within our costing tools, ensuring high quality and predictability

- Actively contribute to development and continuous improvement of CPQ tools

- Act as a goto support for nonstandard and complex costings, enabling informed commercial and project decisions

- Conduct deepdive analyses into project and product cost structures to identify insights, risks, and improvement opportunities

- Collaborate closely with purchasing and production organizations, engineering, sales and project teams to support business success


**Qualifications and experience**

- Minimum of bachelors degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience

- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and understand complex product portfolios

- Fluent spoken and verbal communication skills in English

- Experience with CPQ, ERP, and PLM tools or practical experience in information system development is considered an asset

- Strong skills within Excel are considered an asset


**You are**

- Able to communicate in precise and structured way with a customer-oriented approach

- Self-driven and solution-oriented, able to make things happen and accept responsibility for the results

- Capable of fostering collaboration among stakeholders and supporting effective teamwork.

- Proactive and have a customer focused mindset

- Having a global perspective and being open to different challenges, cultures and ways of operating

- Ready to challenge yourself and develop continuously


**What we can offer you** With us, you will be offered a competitive salary, good benefit package, flexible work hours, and good development opportunities in an international environment. In accordance with the company's remote work policy, you have the possibility for partly flexible remote work. By choosing us, you get to work in an inspiring and safe work environment with sustainable and exciting solutions for the future.

**Work Location** Rauma, Finland

**Point of contact** In case of questions, please contact Sales Support Manager, Merchant – P&H Aleksi Selin, +358 453450788, on: Wednesday 9.9. 15.00-16.00 Tuesday 15.9. 16.00-17.00 Friday 18.9. 15.00-16.00

**Interested?** Please submit your application by 21.9.2026 through our recruitment system.

**Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology.** We deliver advanced solutions to the merchant fleet, offshore, fishing, and naval vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations - both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea. Today, more than **30,000 vessels** operate with our systems on board. Kongsberg Maritime has more than **8,300 employees in 35 countries.**

Technologies for sustainable oceans

Our **Propulsion and Handling division** delivers world class products for propulsion, handling systems and waterjet for all marine industry sectors including merchant, offshore and naval. Our products enhance operational efficiency and deliver safe, secure, reliable and sustainable products to our valued customers.

title: IT Service Manager, UPM, Helsinki
description:
About the role

In this role, you will provide leadership and endtoend service management ownership of global IAM, CyberSecurity and License Management within UPM IT and supplier ecosystem. You will ensure that service delivery from suppliers consistently supports business strategy, resilience, security and longterm value creation across the organization.

You will define and govern ITILbased ITSM frameworks in line with contractual requirements, setting clear expectations for service performance through SLA and KPI models while ensuring strong supplier governance and accountability. As the service manager accountable for service outcomes, you will steer prioritization, risk management and escalations, enabling transparency and informed decisionmaking at both operational and management levels, assuring compliance with; contracts and external/internal controls.

Acting as a key partner to our architectural design personnel, service owners and crossfunctional stakeholders, you will drive service alignment with enterprise roadmaps, support modernization initiatives and contribute to the evolution of scalable, futureready operating models.

Work tasks
- Provide endtoend leadership for IAM and CyberOperations services and suppliers, ensuring reliability, security and alignment with business strategy
- Establish and oversee SLA and KPI models, ensuring measurable service performance, transparency as well as continuous service improvement
- Manage service escalations and act as a single point of escalation for business-critical issues
- Lead and steer the governance forums
- Monitor service performance, risks, and dependencies across integrated services
- Drive service quality, stability, and customer satisfaction
- Ensure services comply with UPM security, cybersecurity, and compliance requirements
- Support budgeting, cost control, forecasting, and financial transparency for services
- Ensure alignment of services with UPM IT strategy, standards, and operating model
- Collaborate closely with Service Owners, Business IT, Architects and local/site IT management
- Act as the primary interface between UPM IT stakeholders and IT service providers

We are looking for

- Advanced knowledge of IT infrastructure, applications, and modern IT solutions
- Experience in stabilizing and improving complex IT services, specifically in IAM or CyberSecurity
- Proficiency in navigating multi-supplier ecosystems within a SIAM model
- Solid understanding of ITIL and ITSM practices
- Strong presentation, facilitation, and reporting skills
- Solution-oriented mindset with high accountability under pressure
- Fluent English skills

It is meritorious if you have
- ITIL certification

To succeed in the role, you also are:
- Change oriented
- Great communicator
- Stress tolerant

Other information:
- Start: As soon as possible
- Employment period: 6 months, possibility to extend
- Location: Helsinki, some flexibility to remote work. Occasional visits to UPM Tampere.

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: IB MYP/DP Instructional Leader for Language Acquisition and Teacher
description:
The school seeks to appoint an **energetic and visionary Instructional Leader** to lead the Language Acquisition department across both the IB Middle Years Programme (MYP) and Diploma Programme (DP). This role combines strategic instructional leadership with teaching responsibilities in MYP and DP Language Acquisition. This is a full-time, permanent position within our IB World School, where inquiry-driven learning, academic rigor, critical thinking, and global citizenship are at the heart of the educational experience. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in shaping teaching and learning across the continuum, fostering innovation, and ensuring excellence in programme implementation.

**Key Instructional Leader Responsibilities**

- **Provide strategic leadership for the Language Acquisition Faculty**, setting a clear vision for excellence and curriculum development aligned with the IB continuum. In this role, you will champion our school's vision to be a community where every student is known, inspired, and challenged.

- **Drive pedagogical innovation and instructional excellence**, inspiring and empowering faculty to implement data-driven, research-informed, and student-centred practices that enhance engagement, conceptual understanding, and authentic learning.

- **Ensure coherent vertical and horizontal curriculum alignment (Grades 6–12)**, safeguarding progression, rigor, and consistency across the MYP and DP programmes.

- **Lead the monitoring and evaluation of instructional quality**, using data, classroom observation, student voice, and professional dialogue to ensure high standards of provision and continuous improvement.

- **Actively contribute to and collaborate with the team of Instructional Leaders and the Pedagogical Leadership Team**, shaping whole-school teaching and learning strategy and ensuring collective efficacy.

- **Safeguard compliance with IB Programme Standards and Practices**, ensuring programme integrity, smooth student transitions across the continuum, and a deep commitment to inclusivity and access.

- **Align faculty goals and instructional strategies with ISHs strategic vision and long-term priorities**, translating whole-school direction into impactful classroom practice.

- **Model exemplary teaching and learning practices**, demonstrating deep pedagogical knowledge and credibility as a leader of learning.

- **Lead professional growth through coaching and mentoring**, building teacher capacity, reflective practice, and instructional leadership within teams.

- **Cultivate trust-based professional relationships**, fostering collaboration, psychological safety, and a positive, high-performing school culture.

- **Promote equity, inclusion, and diversity**, ensuring that teaching practices and curriculum design reflect and value the richness of the school community.

- **Engage in ongoing professional reflection and growth**, using feedback and evidence to refine leadership impact and sustain continuous improvement.


**Key Teaching Responsibilities**

- **Teach Language Acquisition within the MYP and DP pathways**, delivering a rigorous, concept-driven curriculum aligned with IB standards. Experience teaching English, EAL, Finnish, or Spanish would be of interest, and the ability to contribute across more than one language acquisition programme would be an advantage.

- **Design and implement engaging, inquiry-based learning experiences** that promote curiosity, conceptual understanding, and meaningful connections to real-world contexts.

- **Cultivate intercultural understanding, global engagement, and international-mindedness,** enabling students to explore and appreciate diverse perspectives, identities, and cultures through language learning.

- **Develop students confidence and competence as multilingual communicators,** fostering the ability to interpret, create, and exchange meaning effectively in a variety of authentic contexts.

- **Differentiate instruction effectively**, responding to diverse learning profiles, language needs, and abilities to ensure equitable access and sustained academic growth.

- **Assess student learning using IB criteria-based assessment practices**, providing timely, constructive feedback that supports reflection, goal-setting, and continuous improvement.

- **Integrate technology, interdisciplinary learning, and experiential approaches** to deepen engagement and strengthen transferable skills.

- **Collaborate actively with colleagues** to design coherent, cross-curricular learning experiences that support the holistic development of students across the IB continuum.

- **Maintain a culture of vigilance regarding student well-being**, proactively identifying changes in behaviour or engagement and reporting concerns in accordance with the schools safeguarding policies and procedures.


**Salary**

The minimum salary for the position is €3,800 - €4531.33 per month which applies to teachers with 5 years teaching experience, teaching the minimum full time hours. This includes (i) a monthly stipend of €950.10, plus (ii) salary of a full time teacher. Salary is paid according to the higher of the Private Schools collective agreement or the schools own salary scale.

**Qualifications & Experience**

- Bachelors or Masters degree in Languages, Education, or a related field.

- Teaching certification and significant (minimum 5 years) experience teaching Languages, preferably in an IB setting or international school.

- Experience teaching English, EAL, Finnish, or Spanish would be of interest, and the ability to contribute across more than one language acquisition programme would be an advantage.

- Strong understanding of IB philosophy, inquiry-based learning, and global citizenship education.

- Ability to foster debate, discussion, and independent inquiry in the classroom.

- Experience with project-based learning, primary source analysis, and historical inquiry.

- Excellent communication, adaptability, and classroom management skills.

- High levels of proficiency in speaking, reading and writing in English

title: Marketing Specialist (Social Media Influencer)
description:

Appear in social media content and be comfortable representing the company online

Plan, execute and optimise marketing campaigns

Manage creator onboarding and creator communications

Support and manage creators social media accounts and content

Engage with audiences and communities through social media

Demonstrated experience creating engaging social media content

title: Lähihoitaja, sosiaalihuollon resurssiyksikkö, Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue
description:
Haemme ammattitaitoisia ja motivoituneita lähihoitajia varahenkilöstöön toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen vammaispalveluun, mielenterveys- ja päihdepalvelut sekä vanhuspalveluun. Tarvitsemme tiimiimme joustavia ja sopeutuvia ammattilaisia, jotka pystyvät tukemaan yksiköitämme äkillisissä sijaistarpeissa.

Varahenkilönä työskenteleminen on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa. Se tarjoaa loistavan mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistaan ja laajentaa kokemusta eri työympäristöissä. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää joustavuutta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kykyä toimia sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä.

Odotamme, että sinulla on aikaisempaa työkokemusta alalta ja osaamista asiakastyöstä sekä kuntoutuksesta. Erityisesti arvostamme positiivista ja iloista asennetta sekä hyviä yhteistyötaitoja.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Esimiehen täyden tuen ja hyvät työtoverit
- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä monipuolisessa työssä
- Joustavat työajat ja työskentely-ympäristön, joka tukee hyvinvointiasi ja ammatillista kehittymistäsi.

Jos sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot, positiivinen asenne ja intoa työskennellä eri ihmisryhmien kanssa, voit olla etsimämme henkilö. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

Tervetuloa osaksi tiimiämme!


Kelpoisuusvaatimus:
Lähihoitajan tutkinto tai terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun asetuksen (564/1994) tai valtioneuvoston sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä antaman asetuksen (153/2016) mukainen tutkinto.
Tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito maamme molemmissa kansalliskielissä

Valitulla tulee olla voimassa tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 § mukainen rokotussuoja. Lisäksi valitun tulee esittää rikosrekisterilain 6 § 2. mom. tarkoitettu ote rikosrekisteristä.

Sovelletaan koeaikaa.

title: Johtava sosiaalityöntekijä, Soihtu, Salo
description:
Tehtäväsi

Johtavana sosiaalityöntekijänä toimit Asiakasohjaus Soihdun itäisen alueen tiimin lähiesihenkilönä. Vastaat Salon, Salon poliisiasemalla toimivan Ankkuri-toiminnan sekä Paimion toimipisteiden henkilöstön esihenkilötyöstä ja toiminnan kehittämisestä.

Asiakasohjaus Soihtu vastaanottaa ja käsittelee kaikki alle 65-vuotiaiden sosiaalihuoltolain ja lastensuojelulain mukaiset ilmoitukset ja yhteydenotot uusien asiakkaiden kohdalla sekä toteuttaa palvelutarpeen arviointia. Lisäksi Soihtu arvioi ja toteuttaa kiireellisiä lastensuojelun tukitoimia.

Tehtävässäsi toimit moniammatillisen yhteistyön asiantuntijana ja rakennat toimivia yhteistyökäytäntöjä eri viranomaisten, kuntien ja järjestötoimijoiden kanssa. Vastaat osaltasi työn sisällön ja yhteistyöverkostojen kehittämisestä sekä huolehdit sujuvasta yhteistyöstä eri toimijoiden välillä. Tehtävä voi sisältää tarvittaessa myös asiakastyötä.

Toiminta-alueeseen kuuluvat Salo, Somero, Paimio ja Sauvo. Vakituiset toimipisteet sijaitsevat Salossa ja Paimiossa, minkä lisäksi teemme jalkautuvaa työtä alueen muihin kuntiin.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Pääset osaksi sitoutunutta, kokenutta ja moniammatillista työyhteisöä, jossa työtä tehdään yhdessä asiakkaiden parhaaksi.

Salon Soihtu-tiimissä työskentelee johtavan sosiaalityöntekijän lisäksi kahdeksan sosiaalityöntekijää, kuusi sosiaaliohjaajaa sekä sairaanhoitaja. Tiimin tukena toimii myös vakituinen perheterapeutti vahvistamassa systeemistä työotetta.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vaikuttavan tehtävän, jossa pääset hyödyntämään johtamisosaamistasi, kehittämään palveluita sekä tukemaan henkilöstön työhyvinvointia ja ammatillista onnistumista. Etsimme tiimille esihenkilöä, joka johtaa työtä positiivisella sykkeellä ja innostaa myös muita onnistumaan.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Toivomme sinulta vahvaa kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä sekä laaja-alaista sosiaali- ja lastensuojelupalveluiden osaamista. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää hyviä esihenkilö- ja johtamistaitoja, vahvaa sosiaalihuollon lainsäädännön tuntemusta sekä kykyä itsenäiseen päätöksentekoon.

Arvostamme erityisesti kykyä tukea vaativaa asiakastyötä, edistää työhyvinvointia sekä ylläpitää myönteistä ja kannustavaa työilmapiiriä. Lisäksi odotamme sinulta erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja moniammatillisessa toimintaympäristössä sekä valmiutta toimia muuttuvassa ja nopeatempoisessa työssä.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (817/2015) 7 §:n mukainen kelpoisuus tehtävään. Lisäksi tehtävässä edellytetään erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa ja tyydyttävää ruotsin kielen taitoa.

title: Lärare inom småbarnspedagogik till Folkhälsans daghem i Hyvinge
description:
På Folkhälsan jobbar vi tillsammans för en god vardag för små och stora. Vi är en hälsofrämjande organisation och en familjevänlig arbetsplats, som arbetsgivare är vi flexibla och pålitliga. Vi jobbar aktivt för jämlikhet, värdesätter mångfald på vår arbetsplats och uppmuntrar personer med olika bakgrund och som tillhör olika minoriteter att söka jobb hos oss. Kom och jobba med oss!

Folkhälsan Välfärd Ab rekryterar en lärare inom småbarnspedagogik

till daghemmet i Hyvinge för en tillsvidareanställning. Arbetet är på heltid och inleds enligt överenskommelse under hösten 2026.

Hyvinge daghem är beläget centralt i Hyvinge med parker och natur på gångavstånd. Vi finns i samma byggnad som Svenska skolan i Hyvinge och har ett aktivt samarbete samt möjlighet att använda både gymnastiksal och slöjdsal i vår verksamhet. Tillsammans med Svenska skolan i Hyvinge bildar vi en helhet där barnens lärstig fortsätter naturligt från småbarnspedagogiken till grundläggande utbildningen. Välkommen att jobba för en svenskspråkig helhet på en språkö!

Vi erbjuder småbarnspedagogik och förskoleundervisning samt språkbadsinriktad verksamhet. Du tar dig smidigt till daghemmet med tåg eller buss.

Som lärare inom småbarnspedagogik ansvarar du för och planerar den pedagogiska verksamheten. Arbetet sker i en miljö med kunniga pedagoger samt andra sakkunniga. Du är teamledare för ditt arbetsteam. På daghemmet arbetar vi i enlighet med Grunderna för planen för småbarnspedagogik samt Folkhälsans handbok. Vi erbjuder dig en arbetsplats där du har möjlighet att påverka och utveckla ditt arbete. Förmågor så som kreativitet, samarbetsvilja, flexibilitet, kommunikation och hälsofrämjande arbetssätt värderas hos oss.

Behörighetsvillkor är behörighet enligt lagen om småbarnspedagogik (540/2018) eller enligt rådande övergångsbestämmelse (75 §): pedagogie kandidat (lärare inom småbarnspedagogik), lämplig yrkeshögskoleexamen eller tidigare motsvarande examen på institutnivå, t.ex. barnträdgårdslärare eller socialpedagog.

Vi erbjuder dig en inkluderande arbetsgemenskap där alla stöder varandra. Du får tillgång till olika personalförmåner (bl.a. företagshälsovård via Mehiläinen och ePassi-förmån) för att du skall må bra i ditt arbete, samt utbildningsdagar och sektorsspecifika utbildningar i Eduhouse för att få goda förutsättningar för att utvecklas professionellt. Lön enligt kollektivavtalet för den privata småbarnspedagogiken med möjlighet till personliga tillägg.
Den som väljs till arbetet bör uppvisa utdrag ur straffregistret enligt 6 § 2 mom. i straffregisterlagen samt tuberkulosutredning enligt 55 § i lagen om smittsamma sjukdomar. Folkhälsan är en rökfri arbetsplats.

Läs mer om oss här: [Hyvinge daghem - Folkhälsan](https://www.folkhalsan.fi/service/daghem/hyvinge-daghem) och följ oss gärna på Instagram för att se mer av vår verksamhet: [@hyvingedagis](https://www.instagram.com/hyvingedagis/)

För närmare information om jobbet kan du kontakta enhetschef Anna Holmgren per e-post, anna.holmgren@folkhalsan.fi , eller per telefon, +358 44 788 3670.

Använd gärna det elektroniska ansökningsformuläret när du skickar in din ansökan. Vi intervjuar under ansökningstiden och platsen fylls genast då lämplig person hittas.

Vi ser fram emot att få höra mer om dig!

title: Kunnossapitoasentaja, Honkajoki Oy
description:

title: Land Development & Field Clearing Manager
description:
**PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**

Lead the first physical execution phase of the programme: land preparation, field clearing and efficient recovery of biomass generated during clearing.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

· Prepare clearing and land-development plans.

· Tender and manage clearing and earthworks contractors.

· Plan heavy-equipment fleets and production rates.

· Organise biomass recovery, sorting and transport to biochar plants.

· Maintain biomass and timber mass balances.

· Prepare cleared land for the following cultivation phase.

· Control clearing cost per hectare and contractor productivity.

· Ensure environmental, community and HSE requirements are met.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND CAPABILITY**

· Experience in major earthworks, forestry, agriculture, land development or infrastructure projects.

· Strong knowledge of heavy equipment and field productivity.

· Demonstrated site-management experience.

· Ability to manage contractors in remote and developing-site conditions.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

· Tropical or West African project experience.

· Biomass recovery / forestry logistics experience.

· ESG-sensitive land development experience.

**KEY SUCCESS MEASURES**

· Safe hectares cleared to plan.

· Biomass recovery rate and cost per hectare.

· Land handed over on time for cultivation.

**RECRUITMENT PRINCIPLE**

We are looking first and foremost for hands-on implementers with a proven record of taking real industrial or infrastructure projects from planning through procurement, construction, commissioning and operation.

The roles are part of an international renewable-energy, circular-economy, biorefining and industrial side-stream utilisation investment programme with Côte dIvoire as the principal implementation country. The portfolio includes both fast-start production projects and later large-scale industrial investments.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

A reasonable level of working English is essential. French language skills are a major advantage.

**EXPECTED WORKING STYLE**

· Practical, decisive and delivery-oriented.

· Fact-based, using measurable results and documented data.

· Prepared to challenge supplier assumptions and verify operating references.

· Able to work in a multicultural environment and build local capability.

· Understands that pilot testing, customer qualification and phased scale-up are central risk-management tools.

**EMPLOYMENT AND LOCATION**

Employment form, work location and travel requirements will be defined role by role. Some positions may begin in Finland or elsewhere in Europe, but several key roles will require significant presence in Côte dIvoire during implementation phases.

title: (Senior) Legal Counsel @ Arval
description:
Are you an experienced lawyer with a generalist mindset? Are you ready to join a Nordic in-house legal team as its sole lawyer based in Finland?

If you answered **YES**, please keep reading, because you could be the one we are looking for to join **Arval** as a new **(Senior) Legal Counsel**!

**_Arval, BNP Paribas Group Company,_** _was founded in 1989 as a specialist in full-service vehicle leasing and new mobility solutions for its customers, ranging from international groups to smaller companies and individual retail clients. More recently, Arval has diversified its business to become a key player in integrated mobility, addressing a wider audience that includes drivers and private individuals. Arval has over 8600 employees operating in 28 countries with over 1,800,00 leased vehicles._

**As BNP Paribas's in-house lawyer**, you will advise Arval's Nordic business, with focus on Finland. This is a versatile role, and your responsibilities will cover the following areas:

- **Contractual matters:** You will draft and revise contracts with a focus on operational leasing, consumer law, public procurement, insurance distribution, and competition law and data protection.


- **Contract negotiations:** You will support in contract negotiations with customers, partners and suppliers.


- **Ongoing legal support:** You will support particularly Finnish business units in all legal matters (excluding tax and employment law). You will identify and assess legal risks, advise the business on legal matters, and provide regular training.


- **Template updates:** You will develop and maintain legal templates and other documentation.


- **Regulatory monitoring and risk mitigation:** You will monitor applicable legal and regulatory changes and assist in mitigating any resulting legal risks, including by ensuring necessary revisions to legal documentation, policies, and procedures.


- **Strategic legal development:** In addition to day-to-day operational work, you will manage legal projects and contribute to group-wide legal initiatives.


While your primary focus is to support Arval's business units, you will also regularly assist the Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) business line of BNP Paribas. You will spend approximately one working day a week in the BNP Paribas Helsinki office, offering legal support to the CIB business line in the Nordics. This will include advising on transactional matters as well as legal and regulatory projects. You will work closely with the CIB Legal Nordics team and other Nordic legal teams of BNP Paribas Group and business partners assisting them with legal advice linked to Finnish operations.

This position will be mainly based at Arval Finland's office in Vantaa, and you will report to the Regional Head of Legal Nordics Arval, based in Stockholm. BNP Paribas's branch office is in Helsinki city center. Based on Arval's hybrid model, you can work remotely two days a week.

**You may be the person we're looking for if:**

- you have a Finnish Master of Laws degree and ideally 7 to 9 years of relevant professional experience working as an in-house legal counsel and/or at a law firm – international working experience and previous experience in an industrial environment or in finance is considered a plus;

- you are a generalist with a solid background within multiple legal areas and the ability to engage in new legal areas. Some of the areas of law for which we expect you to have solid background is contract and consumer law, public procurement as well as data protection. Experience in AML/CFT regulatory frameworks is a plus. Background in transactional and regulatory legal matters in the financial sector in Finland is an advantage but not a requirement. Ideally, you also have experience providing legal advice and assistance in insurance contract matters;

- you have an independent and solution-driven approach and a proven ability to provide practical, business-oriented legal advice;

- you are a collaborative team player with a strong sense of integrity;

- you have a strong analytical judgement and the ability to assess complex legal and regulatory matters; and

- you have great communication skills and excellent working proficiency in both English and Finnish – knowledge in Swedish, Norwegian or Danish is considered a plus.


**Arval offers you:**

- a pivotal legal role with impact on business decisions: you will be a trusted advisor to management and key stakeholders in the Nordics;

- a role with a wide scope of legal matters across multiple areas and countries, along with opportunities for professional development;

- a high degree of autonomy and responsibility, along with a strong level of trust;

- a professional working environment with an international profile; and

- an inclusive and inspiring company culture with supportive colleagues and a great team spirit.


**Interested?** Send us your CV and cover letter no later than **20 September 2026.** If you would like to discuss the position in more detail, feel free to reach out to Minjon's recruiter Olivia Yli-Pelkonen (+358 40 769 5401 or olivia.yli-pelkonen@minjon.fi).

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Are you an experienced accounting professional with solid expertise in financial accounting and a mindset for continuous improvement?

We are looking for a Senior Accountant to join Valmet Automotive's Finance team.
This is an opportunity to take ownership of a broad accounting and reporting role in an international environment. You will have a key role in ensuring reliable financial information while helping us improve finance processes and ways of working.

You will be part of a collaborative Finance team where responsibilities span financial accounting, tax reporting, finance processes, and reporting activities. The role gives you the opportunity to broaden your expertise, understand finance activities across the organization, and expand your responsibilities over time.


Your role
In this position, your primary focus will be on ensuring high-quality accounting and statutory reporting for Valmet Automotive Oyj.

Your responsibilities will include:
* General ledger accounting and account reconciliations

* Monthly and year-end financial closings and financial statement preparation (FAS)

* Participate in IFRS reporting to support group reporting requirements

* Fixed asset and capital expenditure accounting

To succeed in this role, you bring:

* Solid experience in accounting and financial reporting

* Strong understanding of Finnish Accounting Standards (FAS)

* Good knowledge of taxation, VAT and fixed asset accounting
* Experience with SAP and strong Excel skills

* Fluent communication skills in Finnish and English

title: Hoiva-avustaja, Ikääntyneiden palvelut, Kuntouttava arviointijakso yksikössä, Kaarina
description:
Kaarinan Voivalan Visiitissä työskentelet osana moniammatillista tiimiä ja olet mukana varmistamassa asukkaiden sujuvaa, turvallista ja viihtyisää arkea. Työsi hoiva-avustajana painottuu asukkaiden ruokahuoltoon sekä arjen sujuvuuden tukemiseen. Päivittäisessä työssäsi osallistut hoitotyön avustaviin tehtäviin kuntouttavalla työotteella ja avustat asukkaita heidän päivittäisissä toiminnoissaan. Vastaat ruoka- ja astiahuollosta, mikä sisältää ruoan lämmityksen, tarjoilun ja astiahuollon. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat myös elintarviketilausten tekeminen ja vastaanottaminen sekä pyykkihuollon tehtävät.

Työaika painottuu arkisin aamuvuoroihin, mutta tehtävään kuuluu myös ilta- ja viikonlopputyötä.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle huolellisen perehdytyksen sekä tiimin tuen arjen työssä. Saat mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omaan työhösi ja työvuorosuunnitteluun, ja pääset osaksi työyhteisöä, jossa omaa osaamista kehitetään yhdessä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Tehtävä edellyttää hyvää suomen kielen taitoa ja hygieniapassia. Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on hoiva-avustajan koulutus.

Toivomme sinulta hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja. Arvostamme positiivista ja reipasta asennetta sekä innostusta kehittää omaa osaamistasi yhdessä tiimin kanssa.

Hae tehtävää ja tule mukaan tukemaan asukkaiden sujuvaa arkea merkityksellisessä työssä. Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: RDI Specialist
description:
We are looking for an RDI Specialist to join Karelia University of Applied Sciences in a fixed-term employment relationship for the period 1 November 2026-31 December 2027.

As an RDI Specialist, you will work in the field of international higher education and RDI. The position offers you an opportunity to take on new challenges, build meaningful expert networks, and contribute to the development of education and related project activities with both local and international impact. A central part of your work will be promoting cooperation within the INVEST European University Alliance consortium. You will be supported in your role by Karelias expert RDI support services team.

Your duties will include:
- coordinating the RDI activities of the INVEST Centre of Excellence and research cluster cooperation among staff at Karelia, as well as linking these activities to the development of INVEST education provision and Living Labs
- participating in the networks and expert groups of the INVEST Alliance
- planning and implementing workshops, training activities and international network meetings
- developing the monitoring, reporting and impact assessment of RDI related activities, including preparing analyses and reports to support decision-making
- preparing EU-funded RDI projects in cooperation with Karelias experts and other partners
- maintaining networks and partnerships and identifying new cooperation opportunities
- participating in the implementation and development of Karelias RDI support services and INVEST teamwork

Find out more about the INVEST Alliance online:
https://www.invest-alliance.eu/fi
https://www.invest-alliance.eu/fi/Home/Texts?link=62-center-of-excellence---research---innovation

We expect you to have:
- a suitable Masters degree
- experience in international higher education cooperation and in the preparation, implementation and coordination of projects
- evidence of successful development work
- good knowledge of key EU-funded development programs, and experience in project funding application processes
- readiness to work in international networks, and an understanding of different operating cultures
- the ability to purposefully promote common goals in cooperation with colleagues and stakeholders
- the ability to manage several simultaneous task areas, and prioritize your own work
- good oral and written Finnish language skills (at least B1) and excellent English language skills (C1-C2)
- readiness to travel in Finland and abroad for work assignments

In addition, we consider the following advantages:
- a suitable doctoral degree
- knowledge of RDI activities and the operating environment of higher education institutions
- versatile language skills in addition to Finnish and English

Employment details:
- Collective agreement: Collective agreement for Universities of Applied Sciences (Sivista ry)
- Salary: according to your previous work experience, 3 842,18-5 093,84 €/month.
- Trial period: 6 months
- Working hours: 36.25 hours per week (7.25 hours/day), flexible working hours
- The position requires on-site work at Karelia UAS campuses in Joensuu, with a partial remote work option

We will conduct a background check on the person selected for the position to ensure research security.

Applying:

Please submit your application and CV through Kuntarekry by Sunday 20 September at 20:00. You may complete your application either in Finnish or in English.

Interviews will be held in Joensuu on 5 October 2026. We will contact those invited to interview by phone during week 44.

We are committed to equality and non-discrimination in our recruitment processes and welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds. Our application form is based on the researcher CV template recommended by the Finnish National Board on Research Integrity (TENK). Candidates invited to interview will be selected based on the information and evidence presented in their applications.

title: Ajoneuvonasentaja (Vakituinen työ)
description:
Haemme asiakasyrityksellemme ajoneuvonasentajaa monimerkkikorjaamoon vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Tuusulaan. Oletko juuri sinä etsimämme henkilö?

Yritys tarjoaa laadukkaita huolto-ja korjauspalveluita monimerkkiautoille pitkälla kokemuksella panostamalla asiakastyytyväisyyteen. Töitä tehdään korjaamolla ammattitaitoisen henkilökunnan kanssa. Yritys tarjoaa nykyaikaiset korjaamolaitteet sekä työkalut. Huolettavat ja korjattavat autot ovat pääasiassa bensa- ja hybridikäyttöisiä. Palkkaus määräytyy kokemuksesi mukaan.

Työtehtäviisi sisältää muun muassa erilaiset huolto- ja korjaustyöt, ongelmanratkaisu, vikadiagnostiikan lukeminen sekä asiakkaiden neuvonta ja tehtävien dokumentointi.

Tehtävä edellyttää aiempaa kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä sekä alan koulutusta. Eduksi katsotaan, jos sinulta löytyy kokemusta autosähköosaamisesta.

Aloitus sopimuksen mukaan ja työaika on arkisin klo 8.00 – 16.00.

Kiinnostuitko työtehtävästä? Täytä työnhakulomake osoitteessa alrekry.fi!

Asiakkaamme käyttävät palveluamme työtehtävissä suorittavista tehtävistä ammattitaitoa vaativiin tehtäviin kuin myös suunnitteluun ja johtotehtäviin. Asiakkaamme ovat aktiivisia toimijoita monilta eri aloilta vahvimmin edustettuna teollisuus-, logistiikka-, tuotanto-, palvelu- ja kuljetusaloilla.

Kiinnostuitko! Jos haluat tietää enemmän, soita rohkeasti minulle ja kysy lisää. Tavoitat minut parhaiten ma - pe klo 09.00 - 15.00: 050 380 2656 / Anne Järvelä. Voit myös lähettää viestin sähköpostilla osoitteeseen hr.alrekry@alrekry.fi.

Olemme luotettava ja vakavarainen työnantaja. Olemme toimineet näin jo vuodesta 2004. Pitkä kokemuksemme on osoittanut, että voit luottaa meihin. Olemme luotettava kumppani.
