title: PhD Student in Applied Geophysics
description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.

Luleå University of Technology, together with the Geological Survey of Sweden and several Swedish industrial partners, is launching a multidisciplinary research project on natural hydrogen resource development and underground hydrogen storage.

We are seeking a highly motivated PhD candidate in Applied Geophysics to contribute to this exciting project which offers a unique opportunity to work with leading researchers and industry partners to address one of the key challenges of the energy transition.

As a doctoral student, you will receive excellent supervision, access to advanced research facilities, and opportunities to develop into an internationally recognized researcher.

Subject description

Applied Geophysics includes studies of how the laws and methods of physics can be used to understand the properties of bedrock and soil deposits. This includes development and applications of methods for exploration and investigation of natural resources such as mineral deposits and water, as well as investigation of environmental and infrastructural related issues.

Project description

For this PhD position, the research will focus on evaluating the potential of natural hydrogen production in Norrbotten County in Sweden using an integrated field and numerical modeling approach. Your tasks are to:

- reprocess and jointly model the available regional magnetotelluric (MT), gravity and magnetic data to develop an initial model for screening the subsurface to select areas with H2-potential source rocks;

- acquire and process new MT and controlled-source electromagnetic (CSEM) field data in targeted areas;

- perform integrated 3D modelling of MT, CSEM and gravity or magnetic data from targeted areas to characterise potential natural hydrogen production systems;

- perform model verification and selection of sites with optimum potential for hydrogen generation.

The project is carried out in close collaboration between Luleå University of Technology, the Geological Survey of Sweden, and several Swedish industrial partners. The successful candidate will work closely with researchers specializing in rock mechanics, underground construction, geophysics and geology, while interacting regularly with industrial stakeholders.

Duties

As a PhD student, you will:

- conduct independent research combining field investigations and numerical modelling of multimodal data (taking into account subsurface structural complexity and anisotropy);

- develop methodologies for evaluating and ranking natural hydrogen prospectivity in Norrbotten region;

- publish research findings in leading international scientific journals;

- present research at national and international conferences;

- complete doctoral coursework required for the degree.

The majority of your working time will be devoted to doctoral research. Depending on departmental needs, you may also have the opportunity to gain experience in teaching and supervision.

You will become a member of the Network of Young Scientists (NYS) within CH2ESS, which organizes workshops, field excursions, interdisciplinary networking activities and professional development events.

Qualifications

Applicants must hold an MSc degree (or equivalent) in one of the following areas:

- Geophysics

- Physics (with specialization in electromagnetism or computational physics)

- or a closely related discipline.

A driving license is essential since geophysical fieldwork is required in this project.  Experience in geophysical fieldwork is an advantage. A good background in numerical modelling of geophysical data is also an advantage.

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

- strong analytical and problem-solving skills;

- enthusiasm for scientific research;

- ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams;

- excellent communication skills in written and spoken English.

Knowledge of Swedish is considered an advantage because some fieldwork, industrial interaction and teaching activities may require communication in Swedish, but it is not a mandatory requirement.

title: Industrielektriker till HFSAB
description:
Om företaget

HFSAB is the world's leading supplier of continuous lead extruders with over 60 years of experience in design and manufacture of high-quality machines for cable sheathing. Our portfolio comprises equipment for lead extrusion from single machines to complete turnkey solutions as well as equipment for cable stripping, repair and recovery. Consistent development over decades, staff expertise, service as a core competence and close partnership with our customers have contributed to our success. Our machine components are designed in-house. High stock availability together with a network of established high-quality sub-suppliers for parts provide for consistently high quality and speedy availability. These core competences have been our fundamental claim in the past and will be in future. As an affiliated company of the NIEHOFF Group with several branches worldwide, and with headquarters in Motala, Sweden, HFSAB is an innovative company with the goal and ability in meeting the global demands of tomorrow already today.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som industrielektriker hos oss blir dina huvudsakliga uppgifter att arbeta med elinstallationer samt övervakning av installationer, där du säkerställer att arbetet utförs korrekt och enligt standard. En viktig del i rollen är även dokumentation och strukturering av information, för att skapa tydlighet och långsiktig kunskap i organisationen.

Vi uppskattar om du bidrar med idéer och engagemang kring hur vi kan förbättra vårt underlag och dokumentationsrutiner – här finns utrymme för att påverka och utveckla arbetssättet.

Tjänsten innefattar emellanåt resor både inom Sverige och internationellt, där du representerar företaget och möter kunder. Därför är det viktigt att du trivs i kontakt med människor och i en varierande arbetsmiljö.

Du blir en del av ett team på sju personer med bred kompetens inom både el och mekanik.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som är utbildad elektriker och gärna har erfarenhet av arbete som industrielektriker. Du har goda kunskaper inom installation och felsökning av el på maskiner och är van att lösa problem praktiskt. El-behörighet är meriterande, men om du är på väg mot att färdigställa den kan vi stötta dig i processen.

Som person beskrivs du som självdrivande, initiativtagande och strukturerad. Du ser värdet i att dokumentera och dela kunskap – för att skapa en stabil grund som fler kan bygga vidare på. Du uppskattar variation i arbetet, där både teknik, dokumentation och kundkontakt ingår. Tjänsten kräver att du kommunicerar obehindrat i svenska och engelska samt att du innehar B-körkort.

Ansökningsförfarande

I den här rekryteringen samarbetar HFSAB med Skill. Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Innan anställning slutförs kommer bakgrundskontroll genomföras.

Eftersom vi vill säkerställa ett rättvist och fördomsfritt urvalsarbete önskar vi inget personligt brev, däremot att du svarar på våra inledande urvalsfrågor. Om du går vidare kommer du därefter att få ett mejl med en länk till våra rekryteringstester som på ett objektivt sätt hjälper oss att matcha rätt person till tjänsten.

Vid frågor om tjänsten eller rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Matilda Ingeson på matilda.ingeson@skill.se eller 0705-65 61 31. #LI-DNI

title: Chef/Kock
description:
We are looking for a skilled chef to join the team at ÄNG. You will become part of a close-knit and ambitious kitchen team, with a varied role and plenty of opportunities to learn, develop and contribute.

Experience from a Michelin-starred restaurant is a plus, but not a requirement. A good foundation in fine dining, attention to detail and a genuine interest in cooking are more important to us. We work hard and have high ambitions, but we also believe that a good kitchen should be a friendly and enjoyable place to work.

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the EU/EEA.



ABOUT ÄNG

ÄNG serves a tasting menu based on Nordic ingredients. The restaurant is open for dinner Monday to Friday, with a separate tasting menu served for breakfast Tuesday to Saturday. We close after breakfast service on Saturday and reopen at 17:00 on Monday.

Our cooking is rooted in Halland, while drawing on techniques and influences from around the world. We work mainly with ingredients from the surrounding area and adapt the menu to what is available throughout the seasons.

With the sea around 20 minutes away, seafood and ingredients from the coastline are an important part of the menu. We also work with produce from nearby farms, forests, beaches and fields, including ingredients picked locally each morning.

ÄNG is located at Ästad Vingård, and the vineyard’s organic Scandinavian wines are produced around 100 metres from the restaurant.

Working with a limited geographical area naturally sets some boundaries. For the kitchen team, this means finding new ways to work with the ingredients and conditions available to us.

ÄNG is run by Ann-Catrine Gemzell (General Manager & Sommelier) and Filip Gemzell (Executive Chef).



WHY JOIN ÄNG?

    You will have a personal development plan, set up accordingly to your ambitions and goals.
    The team is always there to help you succeed, as long as you help the team to succeed.
    A great opportunity to connect with nature, vineyards and produce. We can provide assistance with finding accommodation.



APPLY

Apply by sending your CV and cover letter to executive chef Filip Gemzell, at filip@restaurangang.se.

Feel free to get in touch if you have any questions!

With the sea around 20 minutes away, seafood and ingredients from the coastline are an important part of the menu. We also work with produce from nearby farms, forests, beaches and fields, including ingredients picked locally each morning.

ÄNG is located at Ästad Vingård, and the vineyard’s organic Scandinavian wines are produced around 100 metres from the restaurant.

Working with a limited geographical area naturally sets some boundaries. For the kitchen team, this means finding new ways to work with the ingredients and conditions available to us.

ÄNG is run by Ann-Catrine Gemzell (General Manager & Sommelier) and Filip Gemzell (Executive Chef).



WHY JOIN ÄNG?

    You will have a personal development plan, set up accordingly to your ambitions and goals.
    The team is always there to help you succeed, as long as you help the team to succeed.
    A great opportunity to connect with nature, vineyards and produce. We can provide assistance with finding accommodation.



APPLY

Apply by sending your CV and cover letter to executive chef Filip Gemzell, at filip@restaurangang.se.

Feel free to get in touch if you have any questions!

title: Site Manager - Swedish student websites
description:
About the Role

Are you passionate about SEO, UX, data, and digital growth? Do you enjoy turning insights into improvements that create better user experiences and measurable business results?

We're looking for a Site Manager to take ownership of our Swedish student websites, including studentum.se, AllaStudier.se, gymnasium.se, anpassadgymnasieskola.se, and dingrundskola.se. In this role, you'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive traffic, improve conversions, and continuously develop some of Sweden's leading education platforms.

As Site Manager, you'll be responsible for the overall development and performance of our websites. You'll work closely with Product, Tech, Marketing, Content, and Sales to improve the user experience, strengthen our SEO performance, and deliver digital projects that create real impact.

From analyzing user behaviour and planning site improvements to collaborating on new product features, you'll play a key role in shaping the future of our student platforms.

About the Team

You'll join a collaborative team of Marketing Specialists and Account Managers dedicated to creating the best possible experience for both our education partners and prospective students. Together, we ensure our websites provide valuable content, intuitive functionality, and user-friendly tools that help schools connect with the right audience.

Reporting to the Head of Marketing & Service Delivery, you'll work closely with Site Managers across our international markets, sharing insights, best practices, and ideas to continuously improve our platforms. You'll also collaborate closely with our Product, Tech, and SEO teams, where our SEO & growth specialists provide the strategic direction while you help bring those initiatives to life through continuous website optimization, content improvements, and user-focused development.

Responsibilities

    

Own and develop the structure and user experience of our Swedish student websites.

    

Analyze website performance, traffic, and conversion data to identify growth opportunities.

    

Drive SEO initiatives to increase organic visibility and website traffic.

    

Monitor competitors, digital trends, and developments in the Swedish education system to keep our platforms relevant, accurate, and competitive.

    

Define user needs through research, surveys, and customer insights.

    

Collaborate with Product and Tech teams to prioritize new features, report bugs, and implement improvements.

    

Work closely with Content Managers to optimize and develop high-quality contenting.

    

Lead cross-functional projects that improve our websites and user experience.

Requirements

We're looking for someone who:

    

Has experience managing websites, digital products, or SEO-driven platforms.

    

Has solid knowledge of SEO, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console.

    

Has a genuine interest in AI and large language models (LLMs), and enjoys exploring how AI can improve content, SEO, and digital experiences.

    

Enjoys working with data and using insights to improve performance.

    

Is comfortable collaborating across multiple teams and stakeholders.

    

Has excellent organizational and project management skills.

    

Is proactive, curious, and always looking for ways to improve the user experience.

    

Communicates fluently in Swedish and English.

Beneficial, but not required

    

Experience with Ahrefs, Canva, Infogram, Excel and other digital tools.

    

Experience with CRO, A/B testing, and UX optimization.

    

Knowledge of HTML/CSS or working closely with development teams.

    

Experience within publishing, marketplaces, or digital media.

    

Experience working with educational institutions, government organizations, or education marketing.

Why us?

Join an international EdTech company where you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact. You'll work in a collaborative environment, combining data, technology, and content to help millions of people make better education decisions.

    

Opportunity to make a real impact in a growing company

    

Collaborative and international work environment

    

High level of ownership and autonomy

    

Meaningful projects and learning opportunities

Why you'll love working with us

🌍 An international team with colleagues across the world.

🚀 A fast-paced EdTech company with a flat organization and quick decision-making.

📈 Great opportunities for professional growth and career development.

🏢 Modern offices at Karlaplan in Stockholm, flexible working hours, and hybrid work.

☕ Monday breakfasts, fitness sessions, fika, and Friday after-work gatherings.

About Keystone Education Group

At Keystone, you will be working with passionate, professional and high-performance individuals. Together, we have grown successfully into more than 700 talented employees with websites that are recognized as the world's leading search engines for education. Ambition, drive and great ideas help us reach our goals – join us in the next step of your career!

title: Data Engineer - Sustainability & ESG Reporting, Solna
description:
PostNord is making a significant investment in strengthening its sustainability and ESG reporting capabilities towards customers as part of our data‑driven transformation. To support this journey, we are building a new ESG data foundation – and we are looking for an ESG Data Engineer to help define and build it. This is a key role in a new setup, where you will contribute to establishing trusted, scalable and auditable ESG data pipelines that sustainability reporting across the Group will rely on. You will help turn ESG reporting requirements into reliable data solutions from the ground up. The role sits within the Analytics Center of Excellence, responsible for shaping the future data and analytics landscape at PostNord. You will work with our Azure‑based data platform and collaborate closely with sustainability specialists. This position is ideal for someone who wants to take real responsibility, build something fundamental and apply strong technical skills in a purpose‑driven domain.

Your role

As a Data Engineer working with Sustainability & ESG, you will design and maintain data models and pipelines that support:

    Regulatory and statutory sustainability reporting (e.g. CSRD)

    Internal sustainability KPIs and performance management

    Management and operational insights related to climate impact, energy, transport, suppliers, and social responsibility

You will work closely with sustainability experts, business stakeholders, Power BI developers, and the central data platform team to ensure data quality, traceability, and scalability.

Job duties

    Enable a self-service data architecture that provides trusted sustainability and ESG data across the organization

    Design, develop, and deploy fact- and dimension-based data models to support sustainability reporting and analytics

    Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines integrating data from multiple operational, finance, and external sources

    Collaborate with sustainability, finance, and compliance stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into robust data solutions

    Ensure data quality, lineage, and transparency, supporting auditability and regulatory needs

    Collaborate with the Data Platform team to align on architecture standards and best practices

    Work with modern Azure-based data platforms, contributing to scalable and secure solutions

    Strong analytical skills and the ability to apply complex business and sustainability logic to raw data

    Data modeling and data warehousing

    Database design and ETL/ELT development

    Performance tuning and scalable data solutions

    Experience or strong interest in sustainability, ESG, or regulatory reporting domains

    Good understanding of front-end analytics and reporting tools (e.g. Power BI)

    Experience in requirement analysis, prototyping, and stakeholder collaboration

    A collaborative mindset and ability to work closely with business, sustainability specialists, and technical teams
    Preferably hands-on experience with: Databricks, Azure DevOps, Git, (Py)Spark, Python, CI/CD pipelines, Azure Data Platform, Medallion architecture.

Ways of working

You will work in an agile environment, applying a pragmatic SAFe-inspired approach adapted to team and product needs. As a Data Engineer at PostNord, you will remain hands-on, while also collaborating closely with Power BI developers, sustainability specialists, product owners, and domain teams to ensure solutions meet business and regulatory expectations.

Your profile

You have several years of experience as a Data Engineer or BI/Data Engineer in a data-intensive environment. You understand how to design enterprise-grade, reliable, and auditable data models, and you enjoy working close to the business.

You are curious, eager to learn, and motivated by using data and technology to support sustainability, transparency, and responsible business practices.

We offer you

    A flexible hybrid workplace in a prestige-free and collaborative culture

    Opportunities for professional and personal development

    A Nordic working environment with strong values

In addition, we offer:

    Good insurance and occupational pension conditions

    Wellness allowance & access to office gym and swimming pool

    Employee benefits through PostNord’s employee foundation

    Employment according to a collective agreement

We make everyday life easier – and more sustainable

PostNord is the leading supplier of communication and logistics solutions to, from, and within the Nordic region. We aim to make everyday life easier and more sustainable for everyone who lives and works in the Nordics.

We value accountability, courage, and commitment, and we believe diversity and teamwork lead to better outcomes.

Apply

We look forward to receiving your application! For questions about the role, please contact: Pernille Skovborg – Manager of Analytics Center of Excellence at pernille.skovborg@postnord.com.

PostNord offers communications and logistics solutions to, from and within the Nordic region. With our expertise and a unique distribution network, we are developing the basis for tomorrow’s communication, e-commerce, distribution and logistics.

title: Senior Project Manager, Atlassian Cloud Migration
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will lead a strategic migration of a company-wide Atlassian platform from an on-premise setup to Atlassian Cloud. This is a high-visibility program in a complex enterprise environment where technology, information security, risk, compliance, architecture, operations, and business needs all need to move in step.

You will take the program from planning through execution and help secure a smooth, compliant transition with minimal disruption to daily operations. If you enjoy driving cloud transformation in an environment with many stakeholders, clear governance needs, and real business impact, this role offers a meaningful challenge.

Job Description

    You will lead the end-to-end migration program from Atlassian Data Center/Server to Atlassian Cloud.
    You will define and manage scope, timeline, risks, dependencies, and overall delivery structure.
    You will coordinate cross-functional teams across infrastructure, platform, security, compliance, architecture, and business functions.
    You will establish governance forums and provide clear status updates to senior stakeholders.
    You will drive stakeholder engagement, communication planning, and change activities to support adoption.
    You will coordinate vendors and partners where needed and keep all moving parts aligned.
    You will ensure the migration follows enterprise architecture, security, risk, and regulatory requirements.
    You will proactively identify issues and risks and turn them into clear actions and decisions.
    You will oversee testing, cutover planning, business readiness, and the transition to operational support.

Requirements

    Proven track record of leading large-scale enterprise transformation or migration programs successfully.
    Minimum 7-10 years of project or program management experience in complex organizations.
    Experience with SaaS transformation initiatives, cloud migrations, or enterprise platform modernization.
    Strong understanding of project delivery methods including Waterfall, Agile, and hybrid models.
    Ability to manage multiple stakeholder groups and communicate effectively at executive level.
    Experience working with projects that include significant regulatory, risk, and security considerations.
    Strong leadership, facilitation, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
    Ability to work professionally in both Swedish and English.

Nice to have

    Experience with Atlassian products such as Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, and Atlassian Cloud migration programs.
    Experience from banking, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.
    Familiarity with data residency, data governance, privacy, and compliance requirements linked to cloud adoption.
    Experience working in large international enterprise environments with distributed teams.
    Project management certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, or equivalent.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: Student Assistant
employer: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
description:
Studiehandledare på tyska, 50 %

Internationella Engelska Skolan Växjö söker en engagerad studiehandledare på tyska för en deltidsanställning på 50 %.

Som studiehandledare kommer du att stödja en elev i att utveckla sina kunskaper i olika skolämnen genom studiehandledning på tyska. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med elevens ämneslärare, mentor och övrig berörd personal.Arbetsuppgifter

- Ge studiehandledning på tyska, individuellt eller i mindre grupp.
- Hjälpa eleven att förstå ämnesinnehåll, instruktioner och centrala begrepp.
- Stödja eleven i att använda sina tidigare kunskaper och erfarenheter i den svenska undervisningen.
- Förbereda och följa upp undervisningsinnehåll tillsammans med eleven.
- Samarbeta regelbundet med ämneslärare och mentor för att planera stödet utifrån elevens behov.
- Bidra till att utveckla elevens självständighet, studieteknik och förmåga att delta i undervisningen.
- Dokumentera och följa upp elevens utveckling tillsammans med ansvariga lärare.Vi söker dig som

- har mycket goda kunskaper i tyska,
- har goda kunskaper i svenska och/eller engelska,
- kan förklara innehåll tydligt och anpassa ditt språk efter elevens behov,
- har god samarbetsförmåga och ett professionellt förhållningssätt,
- är lugn, ansvarsfull, organiserad och lyhörd,
- delar skolans höga förväntningar på elevernas utveckling samt vårt fokus på trygghet, studiero och lärande.

Pedagogisk utbildning eller tidigare erfarenhet av arbete som studiehandledare, lärare eller elevassistent är meriterande men inget formellt krav.Anställningsvillkor

- Omfattning: 50 %
- Arbetsplats: Internationella Engelska Skolan Växjö
- Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse
- Anställningsform: Enligt överenskommelse

För arbete i skola krävs att du uppvisar ett giltigt utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister.

Skicka ditt CV och ett kort personligt brev . Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

German-Speaking Study Guidance Support, 50%

Internationella Engelska Skolan Växjö is seeking a committed German-speaking study guidance support worker for a 50% part-time position.

In this role, you will support a student in developing their knowledge across different school subjects through study guidance in German. You will work closely with the student’s subject teachers, mentor and other relevant members of staff.Main responsibilities

- Provide study guidance in German, individually or in a small group.
- Help the student understand subject content, instructions and key terminology.
- Support the student in connecting their previous knowledge and experiences with the Swedish curriculum.
- Prepare and follow up learning content together with the student.
- Collaborate regularly with subject teachers and the student’s mentor to plan support according to the student’s needs.
- Help the student develop independence, effective study habits and the ability to participate fully in lessons.
- Document and review the student’s progress together with the responsible teachers.We are looking for someone who

- has an excellent command of German,
- has a good command of Swedish and/or English,
- can explain content clearly and adapt their language to the student’s needs,
- works collaboratively and maintains a professional approach,
- is calm, responsible, organised and responsive,
- shares the school’s high expectations for student progress and our commitment to safety, calm and effective learning.

A teaching or educational qualification, or previous experience as a study guidance support worker, teacher or student assistant, would be advantageous but is not a formal requirement.Employment details

- Scope: 50%
- Workplace: Internationella Engelska Skolan Växjö
- Start date: By agreement
- Form of employment: By agreement

Employment in a Swedish school requires the successful candidate to present a valid extract from the police criminal-record register.

Please send your CV and a short covering letter. Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

title: Kock inom asiatisk matlagning sökes
description:
SVENSKA

Är du vår nästa kock?

Vi är en restaurangverksamhet med fokus på modern asiatisk mat. Nu söker vi en engagerad kock med intresse för asiatisk matlagning som vill bli en del av vårt team i Malmö.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som tycker om att arbeta med asiatisk mat och trivs i ett kök med högt tempo. Du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och arbetar effektivt både självständigt och tillsammans med andra.

Arbetsuppgifterna består bland annat av:

    Tillagning och förberedelse av asiatiska rätter
    

    Förberedelse av råvaror och mise en place
    

    Matlagning efter våra recept och rutiner
    

    Säkerställa kvalitet, smak och presentation
    

    Hålla köket rent och organiserat
    

    Samarbeta med övriga kollegor för att ge våra gäster en bra upplevelse

Tidigare erfarenhet av asiatisk matlagning är meriterande, men det viktigaste för oss är att du är engagerad, arbetsvillig och vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss.

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Tillsvidareanställning
    

    Heltid
    

    Fast månadslön
    

    Arbete både vardagar och helger
    

    Ett trevligt och engagerat team
    

    Möjlighet att utvecklas inom verksamheten

ENGLISH

Are you our next chef?

We are a restaurant business focusing on modern Asian cuisine. We are now looking for a motivated chef with an interest in Asian cooking to join our team in Malmö.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who enjoys working with Asian food and feels comfortable in a fast-paced kitchen environment. You are responsible, organised and able to work efficiently both independently and as part of a team.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Preparing and cooking Asian dishes
    

    Preparing ingredients and mise en place
    

    Cooking according to our recipes and routines
    

    Maintaining high standards of quality, taste and presentation
    

    Keeping the kitchen clean and organised
    

    Working together with the team to provide our guests with a great experience

Previous experience with Asian cuisine is an advantage, but most importantly, we are looking for someone who is motivated, hardworking and willing to learn and develop with us.

What we offer

    Permanent employment
    

    Full-time position
    

    Fixed monthly salary
    

    Work on both weekdays and weekends
    

    A friendly and supportive team
    

    Opportunities to develop within the business

TIẾNG VIỆT

Bạn có phải là đầu bếp tiếp theo của chúng tôi?

Chúng tôi là một hệ thống nhà hàng đang phát triển với định hướng ẩm thực châu Á hiện đại. Hiện tại chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm một đầu bếp yêu thích ẩm thực châu Á để gia nhập đội ngũ của chúng tôi tại Malmö.

Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm ai?

Chúng tôi tìm kiếm một người yêu thích công việc bếp và có hứng thú với ẩm thực châu Á. Bạn có tinh thần trách nhiệm, làm việc gọn gàng, nhanh nhẹn và có khả năng làm việc cả độc lập lẫn cùng đồng đội trong môi trường nhà hàng có nhịp độ nhanh.

Công việc bao gồm:

    Chuẩn bị và chế biến các món ăn châu Á
    

    Sơ chế và chuẩn bị nguyên liệu
    

    Nấu ăn theo công thức và quy trình của nhà hàng
    

    Đảm bảo chất lượng, hương vị và cách trình bày món ăn
    

    Giữ khu vực bếp sạch sẽ và ngăn nắp
    

    Phối hợp với đồng nghiệp để mang đến trải nghiệm tốt cho khách hàng

Có kinh nghiệm về ẩm thực châu Á là một lợi thế. Tuy nhiên, điều quan trọng nhất là bạn chăm chỉ, có trách nhiệm, ham học hỏi và muốn phát triển lâu dài cùng chúng tôi.

Chúng tôi cung cấp

    Việc làm lâu dài
    

    Toàn thời gian
    

    Lương cố định hàng tháng
    

    Làm việc cả ngày thường và cuối tuần
    

    Môi trường làm việc thân thiện
    

    Cơ hội học hỏi và phát triển trong công việc

title: Geotechnical Geologist to Gruvteknik
description:
Do you want to use your geological and geotechnical expertise to solve meaningful challenges in one of the world's most advanced underground mining environments? At LKAB, you will contribute to sustainable mining together with experienced colleagues in a supportive, international team where collaboration, learning and long-term development are central.

The sustainable transformation begins with us

We are facing our greatest challenge yet – ensuring that Sweden and Europe have what it takes to transform. So that we can live the lives we want, both today and tomorrow. In the same way that we strive to improve the future, we are committed to developing everyone who joins us on this journey, both personally and professionally.

Would you like to be part of laying the foundation for the way we live – and for the world around us?

Your role

As a Geotechnical Geologist, you will help build and develop the geotechnical understanding that supports safe, sustainable and future-oriented underground mining. You will work with data collection, geological and geotechnical modelling, technical studies and project development, always in close cooperation with colleagues from different specialist areas. The role gives you the opportunity to contribute with your expertise while continuing to learn from others across geology, rock mechanics, seismology, numerical modelling and project management. 

In the role, you will for example:

    Experience with geotechnical logging and modelling, preferably using Leapfrog.

title: Quantitative Risk Analyst, Credit Risk Data Management
employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
description:
Job ID: 5814

We are looking for Quantitative Risk Analyst [Assistant/Regular/Senior] from all background and level to join our Risk Models Data and Strategy teams that is recognized for its professionalism, competence and capabilities.

Do you enjoy working with data analysis? Do you like solving problems and finding new and innovative solutions? Do you understand the principles of banking and are you able to apply this knowledge in your daily work?

If you have previous experience with Credit Risk models, then great! If you have a flair for data and a genuine interest in analysis, you are also welcome!

About our team

Meet the Credit Risk Data Management, a part of the Risk Models Data & Strategy organization in Risk Models. We have an ambitious development plan for development of IRB models and together with our colleagues in Nordea we’ll be part of creating the future of banking.

The Risk Models Data & Strategy department, is a department consisting of 6 team, each specialized in their own part of ensuring high quality data is supporting the bank capital foundation. We add value to Nordea and our customers by improving Nordea data quality, helping visualizing and create the understanding of our data so modelling teams can build great internal models used for Own Funds calculation and the for risk management.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 

What you’ll be doing

As a Quantitative Risk Analyst, the specific role may vary based on qualifications, but you could i.e. play a valuable role in Data analytics, optimizing data flows, product management or as a data governance specialist. Your role could also include coordinating data related activities and ensuring proper communication within the teams and across other Risk Models areas.

Main responsibilities in this role:

    Root-cause analysis for data quality issues, where we meticulously investigate and identify the underlying reasons for any discrepancies in our data. This is closely followed by data reconciliation, ensuring that our data sets are consistent and accurate across different sources.
    We focus on optimizing data flows and algorithms to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our data processes.
    Own and manage all data used in credit risk models across the end-to-end lifecycle, applying data product mindset to capture, enhance and realize value throughout credit risk models.
    Identify and govern critical data elements though strong knowledge of credit risk models, regulatory expectation and capital.
    Secure our Data Governance framework and processes with focus on effective Data Quality Controls, also ensuring documentation of Data Lineage toward all data providers and consumers for credit risk data.
    Preparing reports and other documentation for senior management and external reporting is also an integral part of our role, ensuring transparency and informed decision-making.

You’ll join an international team with variety of backgrounds and skills. We believe that strong drive and passion for change are fundamental for delivering on our commitments. Bring your background and skills to our team, and you will have plenty of opportunities to collaborate, grow and develop.

Who you are

This is the right role for you if you:

    Have an adaptability to thrive in fast-paced and dynamic environment.
    Are structured and able to coordinate several deliveries simultaneously.
    Are self-driven and able to work independently but also enjoy collaboration with others.
    Have strong analytical skills and keen attention to detail with the ability to analyse complex data and processes to derive meaningful insights.
    Have good communication and presentations skills, are not afraid to speak up and can effectively convey business requirements to IT teams and facilitate collaboration between stakeholders.
    Are curious and proactive, focus on solutions rather than problems and share our enthusiasm for developing and learning and constantly improving your skills and competences.

Your background and skills include:

    Experience with Credit Risk modeling, capital reporting, and understanding regulatory requirements as BCBS239 and TRIM.
    Knowledge of SQL, SAS, Snowflake, Python or similar.
    Master’s degree in finance, economics, engineering, physics, mathematics or similar.
    A strong focus on results, deliveries and deadlines.
    Experience with Big Data would be an asset.
    An interest in finance and technology.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 30/09/2026.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

title: Communication and Coordination Office
description:
Company description:

"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."

Job description:





Who we are looking for



We’re looking for a colleague who can take a leading role in employee communication for Reman+, helping translate strategy, change, and key initiatives into clear messages, effective channels, and meaningful dialogue across the organization. The role combines communication ownership with administrative support, ensuring that leaders and teams stay aligned, prepared, and able to move priorities forward in a structured way.







What you will do



Your days will be varied and dynamic, with employee communication at the heart of the role. You’ll develop, distribute, and manage communication content and channels that build understanding of our mission, strategy, policies, performance, and key company-wide or function-specific initiatives. You’ll support leaders with clear messaging, communicative leadership, and change communication, while also creating opportunities for employee feedback and dialogue.







In addition, you’ll provide structured administrative support such as meeting preparation, presentation and document support and practical planning for leadership activities, events, workshops and site reviews. More examples of what you can expect to fill your days with:








    Work actively with both the assistant network and communications networks to strengthen alignment, share information, and enable effective collaboration across the organization.
    Provide administrative assistance and support to the Head of Reman+ (manage calendar, travel arrangements, coordinate meetings across time zones, etc…)
    Assist with administrative tasks that help keep the team focused and effective
    Plan, coordinate and support the management team in preparing site reviews, regional reviews, leadership meetings and any communication events
    Prepare and refine presentations, reports, and other documents.
    Create and manage employee communication channels such as email distribution lists, online communities, intranet content, newsletters, and social media tools.
    Develop and distribute company communications related to strategy, organizational updates and other key initiatives.
    Coach and train leaders in communicative leadership and change management to strengthen engagement and understanding of corporate direction.











Who you are



You are curious, proactive, and confident in taking ownership. You bring structure to complexity, build trust through clear communication, and enjoy connecting people, ideas, and information to create engagement and momentum.







You collaborate easily across levels and cultures, adapt your style to different audiences, and stay steady when priorities shift. With a positive, solution-oriented mindset, you are eager to learn, quick to adopt new tools, and motivated by finding smarter ways of working together.







What you bring



To succeed in this role, you’ll need experience in employee communication, typically gained through education and around 5 years or more of relevant experience. Experience in communicative leadership, change communication, internal communication channels, and stakeholder management is important. Strong organizational and time-management skills are also essential, as the role includes elements of senior administrative support. You should be comfortable working with Microsoft Office and other productivity and communication tools.



Fluency in English and Swedish is required, and additional languages are a bonus.

title: Student Research Assistant (Amanuens)
description:
We have the power of over 50,000 students and co-workers. Students who provide hope for the future. Co-workers who contribute to Linköping University meeting challenges of today. Our fundamental values rest on credibility, trust and security. By having the courage to think freely and innovate, our actions together, large and small, contribute to a better world. We look forward to receiving your application!

Are you interested in working with communication, outreach and events related to development research? We are looking to hire a student assistant (amanuens) to work with the secretariat of the Swedish Development Research Network (SweDev).

The position

SweDev was founded in 2019 and is a network that connects development researchers across Sweden in order to strengthen collaboration within the research community and to increase interaction between development researchers and practitioners.

Duties for a student assistant can include teaching, administration or participation in research or artistic research. The duties for this position will focus on assisting the SweDev secretariat by maintaining the website, communicating within and outside the network, co-organising and disseminating information about events, monitoring relevant activities and new research findings, and participating in the regular meetings of SweDev's executive committee and steering group.

The person we need

For employment as an amanuens, you must be admitted to higher education at undergraduate or advanced (master's) level.

The person we need is a strong communicator who works independently, is well organised, collaborates well and has an interest in working with digital communication.

The following education, experience and expertise are required:

    experience in development studies, environmental science or political science (Bachelor's degree or ongoing master's studies)
    knowledge of Swedish development cooperation and development-related research
    proficiency in English, spoken and written.

In addition, the following education, experience and expertise will strengthen an application:

    experience of managing social media and/or a website for an organization, or similar experience
    earlier experience of working in the development sector, in Sweden or abroad
    interest in development research and SweDev's work.

The workplace

From the autumn of 2026, SweDev's secretariat will be hosted at https://liu.se/en/organisation/liu/tema – Environmental Change and the Centre for Climate Science and Policy Research (CSPR) at Linköping University.

More information about the activities at the department and unit can be found at https://liu.se/organisation/liu/tema/temam

The employment

The employment is a fixed-term position with a scope of 20 per cent of full-time for up to one year, with possible extension. Starting date as agreed.

An employment as an amanuens is regulated in Chapter 5 of the Higher Education Ordinance.

Salary and employment benefits

Salary according to LiU's central agreement on teaching assistans salaries.

More information about employee benefits is available https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/employee-benefits.

Union representatives

Information about union representatives, see https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/hjalp%20for%20sokande.

Application procedure

Apply for the position by clicking the "Apply" button below. Your application must reach Linköping University no later than September 25, 2026.

Applications and documents received after the date above will not be considered.

We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives - diversity enriches our work and helps us grow. Preserving everybody's equal value, rights and opportunities is a natural part of who we are. Read more about our work with: https://liu.se/en/article/lika-villkor/.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Why Doktor.se

Doktor.se is Sweden's largest digital healthcare provider. We combine physical clinics with a digital platform serving millions of consultations per year across Sweden, Germany, and Norway. Our 25-person engineering team has startup autonomy inside a profitable, international organization with 1,000+ employees and over 1B SEK in revenue.

We run OpenAI and Anthropic models in production across patient and clinician workflows, and that footprint is growing fast.

What you'll do

Our infrastructure works, but it was built to solve yesterday's problems. We need someone who can help us get to where we want to be — not maintain what we have, but reshape it. If you want a place where everything is already figured out, this isn't it. If you want to build something better, here's what you'd own:

    

Build a deployment platform where teams ship their own services without asking you for permission.

    

Design infrastructure that is secure by default, so teams don't have to think about encryption, network isolation, or data residency. It just works.

    

Create deployment pipelines where security scanning, policy checks, and compliance happen automatically, invisible when everything is fine, loud when something needs attention.

    

Support and scale infrastructure for AI workloads, we run models in production across our platform, and that footprint is growing.

    

Set up observability that gives teams real insight into their own services, useful dashboards, alerts that mean something, not noise that everyone ignores.

    

Work closely with developers to understand what slows them down, and then fix it. Not by doing it for them, but by making it easy for them to do it themselves.

    

Maintain and evolve our cloud account structure, networking, and identity management across multiple regions and products.

Some weeks you'll write infrastructure code. Some weeks you'll pair with a developer to debug a slow service. Some weeks you'll design how a new product gets its own isolated infrastructure. The common thread: you make the teams around you better.

Make developers faster, not more dependent on you.

What we're looking for

    

You've built and operated Kubernetes in production. Not just deployed a Helm chart once, you've debugged networking issues, designed RBAC policies, and thought about how multiple teams share a cluster without stepping on each other.

    

You know AWS well. Accounts, networking, IAM, KMS. You have opinions about what should live in Kubernetes and what genuinely needs to be an AWS managed service, and you lean toward keeping things in Kubernetes where possible.

    

You've worked with GitOps and infrastructure as code. Flux, ArgoCD, Terrafor, specific tools matter less than the principle: infrastructure changes go through pull requests, are reviewed, and are auditable.

    

You understand developers because you are one. You can read their code, understand their pipelines, and have meaningful conversations about architecture.

    

You think about security as something you design into systems, not something you review at the end.

    

You have opinions, and you can change them when someone makes a better argument.

    

University degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent experience.

Tech stack

Cloud - AWS (multi-account, multi-region)

Orchestration - Kubernetes / EKS

IaC - Terraform

CI/CD - GitHub Actions

Languages - Python, TypeScript

AI - OpenAI, Anthropic (in production and tooling)

Observability - Datadog / Grafana (you'll shape this)

What we offer

    

Real influence. You'll shape how our platform works, not just operate what someone else designed.

    

Healthcare context. Patient data, regulatory compliance, and real consequences for getting it wrong. What you build actually matters.

    

Small team, direct impact. 25 engineers, your work is visible, not lost in a machine.

    

Autonomy. No micromanagement, no endless approval chains.

    

AI in production. We're running LLMs in patient and clinician workflows today, the infrastructure needs to grow with that.

    

Collective agreement, 30 days vacation, wellness allowance, personal development budget.

Practical details

    

Start: As soon as we find the right person. We'll accommodate your notice period.

    

Employment: Permanent, full-time. Six month probation period.

    

Location: On-site, Monday–Thursday at Sveavägen 63, Stockholm. Fridays are flexible.

    

Language: English is our working language in tech. Swedish is a bonus.

    

Work permit: You must already have the right to work in Sweden.

    

Contact: Karin Bergström, Head of Product and technology

We handle recruitment internally — no agencies, no consultants, no external recruiters.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Langzeitpflege 80-100% für die Region Grabs gesucht
description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Grabs sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Langzeitpflege.

### Ihr Überblick zur Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Grabs

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Langzeitpflege

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Grabs

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Grabs liegt im Rheintal des Kantons St. Gallen und bietet Sie mit einer ausgezeichneten Verkehrsanbindung an. Die Region ist durch die Bahnlinie und das Autobahnnetz gut erreichbar. Als Arbeitsort überzeugt Grabs Sie mit einer starken Industrie- und Gewerbebase, günstigen Bodenpreisen und einer hohen Lebensqualität in unmittelbarer Nähe zum Bodensee und Liechtenstein.

### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Profil – darauf kommt es an

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen in der Langzeitpflege rund um Grabs ist derzeit sehr hoch, da Altersheime und Betreuungseinrichtungen konstant unter Fachkräftemangel leiden. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen und können zwischen verschiedenen attraktiven Positionen im 80–100%-Pensum wählen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, passgenauen Stellenvorschlägen und dem Netzwerk zu etablierten Arbeitgebern in der Region, was Ihnen einen reibungslosen Einstieg garantiert.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Grabs

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**

- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Kaiseraugst sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Entzugsstation.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Kaiseraugst: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Entzugsstation

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Kaiseraugst

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Kaiseraugst liegt strategisch günstig im Kanton Aargau nahe Basel und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung mit direktem Zugang zur Autobahn sowie zu Bahnverbindungen. Die Nähe zu Basel und das Dreiländereck machen die Region für Arbeitnehmende äußerst attraktiv, da Sie von einer stabilen Wirtschaft und vielfältigen Jobmöglichkeiten profitieren. Zugleich bietet Kaiseraugst Ihnen Wohnqualität mit ländlichem Charme und guter Infrastruktur.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Kaiseraugst aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Entzugsstation

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Kaiseraugst verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

title: Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval
description:
Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen belongs to the group of Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine and manufactures high quality pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and medical devices. Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.

We are a Private Recovery Clinic, experts in addiction and affective disorders, providing exceptional treatment and care to an international clientele. title: Commercial Excellence Lead (m/f/d)
description:
Within the Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EEMEA). Commercial Operations & Strategy Organization, the Commercial Excellence Lead will elevate commercial excellence across the region, enable strong alignment across multiple functions and divisions, and lead commercial-capability readiness for our emerging launch pipeline in EEMEA. Strong, trusted partnership with cluster commercial operations teams is essential to the success of this role. Key stakeholders will be the EEMEA Leadership Team (LT), HHI Commercial Operations, regional Chief Marketing Officers (CMO) & Regional Commercial Leads (RCL), and market Commercial Operations Directors (CODs.)
This is a Band 400 individual-contributor role. The primary location is Switzerland, with secondary locations in the Europe or Middle East time zones may be considered upon further discussion with the hiring manager. The role includes approximately 25% travel within Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa.
Responsibilities:
Commercial Capabilities:  Drive customer engagement evolution in partnership with Digital Engagement teams, ensuring commercial capabilities, segmentation, omnichannel execution and customer insights are translated into improved customer experience and business outcomes.
Relevant focus areas include:
•    Sales Force Effectiveness: Ensure proper Sales Incentive Plan (SIP), target setting, CRM operations and upgrades, and Sales Force of the Future (SFOF) deployment in select markets.  Ensure an ongoing focus on segmentation and targeting and Multichannel Cycle Plans (MCCP) efforts in the region.  Leverage data, analytics and business insights to improve sales force effectiveness in the region.
•    Key Account Management:  Ensure the roll out of Key Account Management and Top Customer programs in the region. Ensure successful capability roll-out and work with Market Access and Franchises to increase access at account level.
•    Commercial Trade Channels: Align with HHI on new capability roll-out and support markets in uncovering Commercial Trade Channel (CTC) opportunities.
Operational Governance & Execution:  Work with all relevant stakeholders to secure the EEMEA Commercial Operations & Strategy (CO&S) vision and business strategies and proactively identify and execute projects and programs of strategic importance to the region and our customers in a timely, effective, and efficient fashion. Be the communicator / connector / catalyst for cross-functional projects managed by extended regional stakeholders. Relevant focus areas include:
•    CO&S Governance: Manage all governance activities for the CO&S department, including setting the agenda for virtual and face-to-face meetings and periodic forum calls with market leads and other relevant stakeholders.
•    Business Impact Measurement: Establish measurement frameworks to evaluate the impact of commercial capability investments, ensuring visibility to adoption, effectiveness, customer outcomes and business value realization.
•    Continuous Improvement: Continue to identify opportunities to drive simplification and harmonization across the region in collaboration with CO&S stakeholders including Digital Human Health (DHH). Support markets and the region in Objective & Key Result (OKR) transformation projects where requested.  Bring external industry best practices and innovative approaches into the region to continuously elevate commercial excellence.
•    Marketing Capabilities: Partner with regional Learning & Development (L&D), CMOs, and RCLs to build and scale marketing capabilities with a focus on L3 next deployment and sustainment.
•    Regional Projects: Ensure the successful deployment of projects associated with regional initiatives, priorities, and experimentations.
Launch Excellence:  Lead commercial-capability readiness that carries our emerging pipeline to flawless launch execution across markets. Relevant focus areas include:
•    Launch Capability Readiness: Partner with RCLs and market teams to ensure markets have the appropriate Go to Market (G2M) planning, segmentation, targeting, field-force sizing, training, forecasting support, and launch playbooks are in place well ahead of launch.
•    Launch Framework & Tracking: Establish a repeatable EEMEA launch-excellence framework and toolkit, with launch tracking that gives leadership visibility to timelines, milestones and risks.
AI-Enabled Commercial Excellence:  Champion the responsible adoption of GenAI across commercial workflows — helping teams work faster and smarter while safeguarding compliance and quality — and explore opportunities to embed AI into sales, marketing, field-force and launch ways of working, in partnership with key stakeholders.
Talent Development:  Build & support commercial-operations talent and capability development across the region.
We are looking for a commercially minded leader with 10+ years across sales, marketing, commercial operations and launch readiness who has successfully deployed commercial excellence capabilities in a complex, multinational environment. Combines strategic thinking with execution discipline, excels at influencing without authority, and has a strong track record of leading change, building capabilities, and translating data and technology into measurable business outcomes.
